title: a_break_1
transcript: I take a short break But I must study now
asset_description: A young man studying at a desk with an open textbook takes a break to look at his phone, laughing at what he sees. His amusement slowly turns into wide-eyed panic as he realizes how much study time his short break has eaten.
speech_sentences: I take a short break But I must study now

title: a_certificate_2
transcript: I study very hard. Look at all my certificates!
asset_description: A smiling young woman stands in her room and proudly shows framed certificates to the camera, swapping one for another until she is hugging a whole armful of them.

title: a_class_3
transcript: I look away for one second. My class is crazy!
asset_description: A teacher writes a quadratic equation on a chalkboard; every time she turns her back, her class erupts into total chaos with students dancing on desks and throwing paper. When she turns around with her coffee mug, everyone is sitting quietly, leaving her baffled.
speech_sentences: I look away for one second.

title: a_course_4
transcript: I am at home. I take a course online.
asset_description: A young woman sits at a table at home with an iced coffee, opens her laptop and calmly works through an online course, sipping and typing.

title: a_cushion_6
transcript: Ouch! It's not enough. Ah, yes.
asset_description: An animated man sits on a hard window bench and winces, rubbing his sore back. He fetches a yellow cushion, sits on it happily, then comically piles up more and more cushions and gives a thumbs up.

title: a_graduation_7
transcript: Today is my graduation. I am so happy!
asset_description: A young man in a navy cap and gown with a gold sash stands in a packed stadium at his graduation ceremony. He raises his diploma and cheers as golden confetti rains down.

title: a_keycard_8
asset_description: An anime woman wheels her suitcase down a hotel corridor and taps her keycard on a door reader, which flashes red. She checks the card, tries the correct door, the reader turns green, and she opens the door to her room.

title: a_laboratory_9
transcript: I work in a laboratory. I do experiments every day.
asset_description: A scientist in a white coat pulls on purple gloves in a laboratory, pipettes blue liquid into rows of tubes, writes notes on a pad, and stores a rack of samples in a lab freezer.

title: a_leaf_10
asset_description: A cartoon botanist in a greenhouse admires a giant green leaf, tracing its glowing veins in wonder. He presses it flat on a table, and when water suddenly pours from above he holds the huge leaf over his head like an umbrella.

title: a_library_11
transcript: This library is beautiful. Look at all the books.
asset_description: A woman in a mustard coat walks through a grand old library, gazing up in awe at endless shelves and a huge circular tower packed with thousands of books.

title: a_napkin_13
asset_description: An animated waitress at an outdoor restaurant folds a white napkin into an elegant fan shape and presents it on a plate with a proud 'Ta-da'. She then tastes soup, dabs her mouth with a napkin, tucks one into her collar and sits down happily.

title: a_page_14
transcript: I make my page pretty. I add flowers to it.
asset_description: Hands flip through an empty notebook, then use tweezers to arrange a pressed yellow flower and green leaves on the bottom corner of a page, brushing glue to fix the decoration in place.

title: a_pill_15
asset_description: In a cartoon mountain cabin, a man sits at a table holding his aching head. His friend hands him a small white pill and pours a glass of water; he swallows the pill, drinks, and soon smiles feeling better.

title: a_presentation_16
transcript: Hello. Today I give a presentation to my class. This is my work. I am a little nervous. Thank you for listening.
asset_description: A student in a dark red sweater stands in front of her class next to a projector screen with slides, speaking and gesturing at the bullet points while classmates watch.
speech_sentences: Today I give a presentation to my class.

title: a_project_17
transcript: We build a wooden shed. It is a big project.
asset_description: A group of friends in a field measures and marks planks, drills them together, raises wall frames, and step by step builds a complete wooden shed, celebrating together in front of the finished build.

title: a_root_18
asset_description: An anime girl in overalls kneels in a garden and lifts a seedling out of the soil, revealing its long pale roots. She shakes off the dirt, rinses the roots in a bowl of water, replants the seedling and waters it.

title: a_ruler_19
transcript: A ruler makes us a straight line. I have no ruler!
asset_description: A student at a classroom desk needs a straight line but has no ruler. He comically tries the edge of a thick book and a calculator and even searches under the desks, until he finally gets a wooden ruler and happily draws a perfect straight line.
speech_sentences: A ruler makes us a straight line.

title: a_schedule_20
transcript: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.
asset_description: Four labeled items lie on the floor representing a full schedule: a textbook 'Revise', a laptop 'Work', a gym backpack 'Gym' and a pillow 'Sleep'. A hand hovers over the choices and, one by one, everything disappears until it grabs the pillow - sleep wins.
speech_sentences: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.

title: a_school_21
transcript: This is my school. Come and see it.
asset_description: A first-person tour of a school: walking up to the entrance doors at sunrise, through locker-lined hallways, past a classroom of chatting students, the library shelves and the cafeteria line, ending outside on the lawn in front of the school building.

title: a_scientist_22
transcript: A normal person looks fast. A scientist looks at everything.
asset_description: In a hallway of research posters a student glances at one and walks on, but a scientist in a white lab coat and safety glasses stops, inspects every chart up close, points at curves, scribbles notes on a clipboard and beams with excitement.

title: a_speech_23
transcript: Thank you all for coming. You changed my whole life. For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!
asset_description: An animated woman in a green suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a grand hall and gives a heartfelt speech; she gestures, toasts to the next ten years, and the seated audience smiles and applauds.
speech_sentences: For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!

title: a_spoon_24
asset_description: In an anime-style seaside kitchen a girl takes a spoon from a cutlery drawer, admires it in the window light, scoops steaming soup from a pot to taste, then happily eats a whole bowl of soup with the spoon until it is empty.

title: a_stapler_25
asset_description: A retro cartoon office worker taps a stack of pages, staples them with his red stapler, then faces an absurdly tall tower of paper; he reloads the stapler with fresh staples, works through the pile and triumphantly lifts the stapled stack overhead.

title: a_straw_26
asset_description: A cartoon man at a beach bar stretches a striped bendy straw, drops it into his iced juice and slurps the whole glass empty through it in seconds; he turns the empty glass upside down and proudly points the straw at the camera.

title: a_student_27
transcript: I am a student. I study until my coffee is cold.
asset_description: A young woman in a red beret and glasses studies at a desk stacked with books while her mug of coffee steams; she reads for so long the coffee goes cold, so she comically dumps an ice tray into it, throws the window open and drinks it iced without stopping her studying.
speech_sentences: I study until my coffee is cold.

title: a_subject_28
transcript: School has many subjects. Some subjects are very hard.
asset_description: A presenter in a cream blazer shows school subjects in quick cuts: equations on a blackboard, a calculator, paint and brush strokes, piano keys and sheet music, a glowing chemistry flask, then she leans on a stack of textbooks and talks to the camera.

title: a_telescope_29
transcript: I look at the moon with my telescope. I see something amazing!
asset_description: At night a woman in a beanie sets up a telescope on a tripod in her backyard and looks through it at the moon; magnified views show craters and a bright meteor streaking past a crescent moon, and she looks up amazed and tells the camera what she saw.
speech_sentences: I look at the moon with my telescope.

title: a_textbook_30
transcript: My textbook is very long. It is so boring.
asset_description: A student sits at a small desk flipping through an enormous, thick textbook, turning page after page with a bored face; the pages never seem to end, and she finally gives up and falls asleep with her head on the book.

title: a_university_31
transcript: In week one, my university is full. In week five, it is empty.
asset_description: A huge university lecture hall is packed with hundreds of students on laptops and phones in week one; the camera then shows the same auditorium in week five, with row after row of empty seats and only a couple of students left.
speech_sentences: In week one, my university is full.
In week five, it is empty.

title: a_word_32
transcript: We play a word game. Say a word fast. Barber. Bowling!
asset_description: A couple on a couch films themselves playing a word game: a letter B pops up on screen, they think hard, pull faces and race to shout words that start with B, cheering and celebrating after each answer.

title: ache_33
asset_description: A cartoon man sits in a clinic waiting room holding his swollen cheek in pain; he presses a cold pack against his jaw, groans with a toothache, and winces even harder when he tries to sip his hot coffee.

title: activity_34
transcript: We're so bored. Best afternoon ever!
asset_description: A bored couple lies upside down on the sofa, then suddenly jumps up and runs into the sunny garden to play badminton; they chase and dive for the shuttlecock, laughing, until they collapse happily on the grass while their dog runs around them.

title: actor_35
asset_description: On a film set a young man gets his makeup done in a director's chair, steps to his mark in front of the camera, and after the clapperboard snaps he performs an intense, tearful scene straight into the lens; the crew applauds and he bows and celebrates.

title: adore_36
asset_description: In a cozy Pixar-style living room a woman scoops up her chubby orange cat, lifts it into the sunlight, hugs it tightly against her cheek and kisses its head while the cat squeezes its eyes shut contentedly.

title: advance_37
transcript: Come on! Keep coming! We made it!
asset_description: Three roped mountain climbers in colorful jackets push forward step by step up a snowy ridge, advancing toward an orange flag planted on the summit; they reach the top together and throw their arms up in triumph.

title: airport_38
asset_description: A Pixar-style ground marshaller in an orange vest waves his batons on the runway of a busy airport; a smiling cartoon plane taxis right up to him while other planes take off past the control tower behind them.

title: ambulance_39
asset_description: From a street cafe a man shields his eyes and watches an ambulance drive up a pastel-colored street and pull over; two paramedics in high-vis uniforms climb out with a red medical bag and stride off toward their call.

title: an_answer_40
transcript: I ask a question. The card gives me my answer. Really? Again?
asset_description: A woman spreads a deck of white cards into a fan on the table, asks a question, and draws one card as her answer; it reads 'You have to wait' and she stares at the camera in annoyed disbelief.
speech_sentences: The card gives me my answer.

title: an_argument_41
transcript: I said to the left! No! It's perfect here!
asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a couple hanging a picture frame shout at each other about where it should go, pointing fingers forehead to forehead with steam rising, then cool off, laugh and hang the picture together.

title: an_exam_42
transcript: This exam's too hard, I just believe.
asset_description: A young man in a basketball jersey sits at a dim table completely covered in exam papers and worksheets; he leans over the pages, flips through them and gives up, walking away from the table.
speech_sentences: This exam's too hard, I just believe.

title: anger_44
asset_description: A flower-market worker finds her flowers dumped in a bag on the table and boils over: she grabs her head, hurls the bag down, kicks a bucket across the empty hall and stands over the flowers shaking with clenched fists.

title: angry_45
asset_description: A woman walks into a laundromat and finds her wet clothes thrown out of the machine onto the floor; she picks them up, then confronts the man who did it, glaring and shouting at him with a furious face.

title: apple_46
asset_description: In an orchard a woman picks a big dark-red apple from the tree, polishes it on a cloth and bites into it with delight; later she and a friend slice it in half on a tree stump and each eat a piece.

title: arena_47
asset_description: A father and son walk through a dark tunnel and step out inside a huge indoor arena packed with thousands of fans around a basketball court; they gape at the stands in awe, then cheer and throw their popcorn in the air.

title: arrive_48
transcript: I arrived this is my hotel. I am so happy to arrive here look at the sea
asset_description: A man films himself arriving at a beach resort: he walks up the palm-lined path, cheers at the entrance, unlocks his room door with a key card, tours the room and steps onto the balcony overlooking the turquoise sea.
speech_sentences: I arrived this is my hotel.
I am so happy to arrive here look at the sea

title: arrow_49
asset_description: On a misty field an archer holds a feathered arrow up to the camera, nocks it on her bow and shoots at a distant target; the arrow hits the bullseye and she pulls it out and shows it proudly.

title: a_jar_50
asset_description: A black-gloved hand pipes thick swirls of pastel whipped body-butter cream from a piping bag into small clear jars on a white table; rows of already-filled jars stand in the background.

title: squeeze_51
asset_description: Under a spotlight a hand presses into a flat disc of clear slime packed with colorful water beads, then grabs handfuls and squeezes them again and again so the slime bulges out between the fingers.

title: assistant_52
transcript: Long lens, please. Already here. Light, light. A bit left. You are the best.
asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a photographer shoots a model in a desert canyon while his assistant hands him the long lens, holds up the reflector, passes him a drink and gets a grateful thumbs-up.

title: athletics_53
asset_description: At a stadium track meet, athletes compete in different events: a woman sprints over hurdles, a man leaps into the long-jump sand pit, and a woman hurls the shot put, then the three celebrate together.

title: atm_54
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style animation, a woman slides her card into a street ATM at night, types her PIN, takes the banknotes from the lit tray and her card back, then buys a bouquet of sunflowers with the cash.

title: auction_55
asset_description: In a packed country hall a young woman raises her numbered paddle again and again, bidding against the crowd on an antique chest and a grandfather clock while the auctioneer's gavel falls; she wins and hugs her paddle.

title: autumn_56
asset_description: In a park blanketed in orange leaves, a woman in a mustard coat catches falling leaves and throws them in the air; a man rakes a huge leaf pile and she runs and jumps into it, sinking in and laughing.

title: back_57
asset_description: Three friends with popcorn leave the crowded rows near the stage of an open-air amphitheater and climb the stairs all the way up, then sit happily in a completely empty row at the back, far from the concert.

title: backpack_58
asset_description: In an anime style, a girl on old stone steps packs clothes and a bottle into a large orange backpack, swings it onto her back, clicks the chest and waist buckles, and hikes up through the town to a lookout over the rooftops.

title: backward_61
transcript: Don't look! Just walk! I told you!
asset_description: In a hand-painted animation, an elderly woman and a big bearded man walk backward down an autumn park avenue, arms out for balance, glancing over their shoulders while a duck watches; they finish with a high five.

title: bag_62
asset_description: A cartoon man with sunglasses and a moustache packs apples, a baguette, a sandwich and a water bottle into a big tan bag on a picnic blanket; an apple drops out, he picks it up, puts it back and closes the bag.

title: baking_sheet_65
transcript: one layer always golden listen to it it's
asset_description: In a log-cabin kitchen a woman shows a black baking sheet, lines it with parchment, arranges potatoes, peppers and carrots in one layer, oils them and slides the sheet into the oven; later the couple pulls out the roasted vegetables and the man tastes one.
speech_sentences: one layer always golden listen to it it's

title: baking_66
transcript: Not near! Let it rise! Listen, perfect!
asset_description: A woman in an apron kneads and shapes bread dough, scores it and puts it in the oven; she and her partner watch the loaf rise through the glass, then pull out the golden bread, set it on a rack and smell it happily.

title: banana_67
transcript: Flip it, pinch! Works every time!
asset_description: On a tropical balcony a man picks a banana from a hanging bunch, and a woman shows him how to open it; he pinches the bottom end, peels it, takes a bite and grins at the camera.

title: bandage_68
asset_description: On the bench of a sports hall, a physio wraps an elastic bandage around a handball player's wrist and hand, fixes the end, and the player flexes her wrist and gives a thumbs up and a smile.

title: barbell_69
asset_description: In a gym two people load big black plates onto a bar and clip them tight; a blonde woman chalks her hands, grips the heavy barbell and deadlifts it to a stand while friends watch, then drops it and celebrates.

title: barber_70
transcript: Short on the sides, please. Say no more. Whoa! I look great!
asset_description: In a Pixar-style barbershop a client sits with a giant afro and huge beard; the moustached barber trims it all with clippers, comb and scissors, then shows the neat new cut in a hand mirror and the delighted client admires himself.

title: bark_71
asset_description: In a northern forest a young man and woman touch and knock on the thick cracked bark of a pine while a woodpecker clings to the trunk; they then walk to a birch and peel off a small curl of its papery white bark to show the camera.

title: basketball_72
transcript: Hey! No way! Woohoo! Oh God! That was good!
asset_description: In a Pixar-style street court a tall girl in a yellow jersey dribbles between two defenders, drives to the hoop, leaps and dunks the ball, then hangs on the rim as everyone hugs and celebrates.

title: bat_74
asset_description: A fruit bat hangs upside down from a cave ceiling at dusk, opens its big eyes and stretches its wings, then drops off and flies out over a still lake under a pink sunset sky, its reflection skimming the water.

title: flap_75
asset_description: A fruit bat hangs head-down from a cave roof, then opens and beats its big leathery wings; it drops into the air and beats them across a red sunset sky where a whole stream of bats is doing the same over the water.

title: battery_76
asset_description: In a cabin a woman clicks a dead flashlight, unscrews it and tips out the old batteries; she and her friend compare them with fresh ones, load the new batteries in, and the flashlight lights up the table as they cheer.

title: beach_78
asset_description: Bare feet walk along warm sand by the surf; a hand lets sand pour through its fingers, then a young man and woman build a sandcastle with a bucket and red spade until a wave washes it, and they run laughing into the sea.

title: bear_79
asset_description: A huge brown bear charges through a misty river, splashing after a fish, then rears up on its hind legs dripping water, shakes its fur in a spray and stares straight at the camera.

title: beard_80
asset_description: At an outdoor tea table a man proudly combs and strokes his chest-length black beard while his bald, clean-faced friend rubs his own bare chin and mimes despair; they compare, laugh and take a phone photo with the comb in the beard.

title: beauty_81
asset_description: A young couple wanders through whitewashed Santorini lanes at sunset; the woman smells pink bougainvillea flowers, admires her smiling face in a hand mirror and twirls in a white dress on a terrace above the sea while they take in the glowing view.

title: bee_82
asset_description: A fuzzy bumblebee lands on a purple clover flower in a meadow, crawls over the bloom collecting nectar, then flies across the field to a wooden hive box and squeezes in through the entrance hole.

title: beer_83
transcript: Tilt and straighten in. Perfect foam.
asset_description: In a beer garden a man pours a bottle of golden beer into a tilted glass, straightens it for a perfect foam head and levels the foam with a knife, then clinks glasses with a woman at a picnic table and they drink.

title: belt_84
asset_description: In a hand-painted seaside cottage a man's loose trousers keep slipping down; he panics, grabs a brown leather belt hanging on a chair, threads it through the loops, buckles it and happily dances now that his trousers stay up.

title: betray_85
transcript: Ready? I trust you. I promise. Fall back! You promised me!
asset_description: In a 3D-animated hay field a kid pinky-promises a big farmer to catch him; the man does a trust fall, the kid steps aside and he crashes into the hay, sitting up covered in straw and betrayed while the kid grins.

title: bill_86
transcript: A little paper. Oh no! (laughs) - And keep it. - Fair. - Worth every bit.
asset_description: A waiter places a folded restaurant bill on a plate; the couple unfolds it and it turns out comically long, the woman gasps and laughs, then the man counts out a thick stack of dollar notes onto the plate and they pay cheerfully.

title: bird_87
asset_description: A round orange-breasted robin perches on a blossoming branch in a garden, sings with its beak wide open, flutters its wings and tail, then flies off across the lawn and lands on another flowering branch to keep singing.

title: a_dog_88
asset_description: A person holds a black-and-tan dachshund up to the camera against a blue sky in a garden; the long-eared dog looks around calmly, then leans its nose right into the lens for a close-up sniff.

title: a_cat_89
asset_description: A black cat sits on the top platform of a tall cat tower in a bedroom while a tabby cat sits in the level below; the black cat peers over the edge and finally leaps off the tower with its front legs spread wide.

title: a_puppy_90
asset_description: A happy black pug puppy stands upright on its back legs in a bathtub of shallow water, tongue out, bouncing and paddling its front paws like a little dance in front of shampoo bottles.

title: blame_91
transcript: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him
asset_description: In a 3D-animated kitchen a mother finds a flower pot knocked over with soil and paw prints on the floor and angrily points at her teenage son; he denies it and points at the dirt trail, and the paw prints lead both of them to point at the guilty cat under the table.
speech_sentences: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him

title: blanket_92
transcript: Warm at last! Share the cover!
asset_description: In a snowy-log-cabin living room a woman throws a huge chunky knit blanket over herself on the sofa and snuggles in; a man walks up, she opens the blanket, and they end up wrapped in it together holding mugs of tea.

title: blender_93
asset_description: A retro-cartoon man in a green tracksuit drops strawberries, a banana and milk into a blender, blends it into a pink smoothie, opens the lid and gets a blob of smoothie on his nose, tastes it, then pours the drink into a glass and gives a thumbs up.

title: blink_94
transcript: Shut! Open! Shut! Open! Ha! Gotcha! You too!
asset_description: In a cel-animated diner a couple has a staring contest over milkshakes; the man's eye waters and twitches until he finally blinks, the woman points at him in triumph and teases him, and they both burst out laughing.

title: blush_95
asset_description: At a white vanity a girl dips a big brush into a round pink blush compact, sweeps it onto her cheeks in front of the mirror while her friend watches, and both admire the fresh pink glow, framing her face with their hands.

title: board_96
transcript: I board the plane. I show my ticket and walk to my seat.
asset_description: POV of a traveler scanning her boarding pass at the airport gate, walking down the glass jet bridge, being greeted by a flight attendant at the plane door, moving along the cabin aisle and settling happily into her seat by the window.
speech_sentences: I show my ticket and walk to my seat.

title: boil_97
asset_description: In a hand-painted mountain hut a girl in a red shawl tends a copper pot over an open fire; the water goes from still to small bubbles to a rolling boil with steam, and she lifts the pot with a cloth and pours the boiling water into a clay teapot.

title: a_hammock_98
asset_description: In a 3D-animated holiday scene a young woman lounges in a rope hammock strung above a blue-domed island view, swaying gently while she reads; the netting and its ropes frame her through the whole clip.

title: book_99
transcript: One more page. The end. Wow.
asset_description: A red-haired woman curled up on a cozy window seat under a tartan blanket with a cat reads a green hardcover book, turning the pages; her friend points at it approvingly over a mug, and she finishes the last page and hugs the book happily.

title: boots_100
asset_description: A hiker laces up tall brown leather boots on a muddy hill path, then stomps through puddles and mud and climbs onto wet rocks with a border collie alongside; the group continues up the green trail in their boots.

title: bored_101
asset_description: A young woman sits alone on a row of waiting-room chairs under a wall clock. She fiddles with her keys, sighs, stares at the ceiling and slowly slumps sideways in her seat as the wait drags on.

title: boredom_102
asset_description: A cartoon man in a purple tracksuit waits in a laundromat and slowly loses his mind from boredom: he watches the clock, balances stacked cups on his head, blows a feather, spins his laundry bag on one finger, slides off his chair and ends up wearing a wet sock on his head.

title: a_laundromat_103
asset_description: A young man kills time at night in a room lined with big washing machines and dryers: he slumps on the steel folding counter, slides a coin about, checks the wall clock and finally stretches out flat across the plastic waiting chairs.

title: bottom_104
asset_description: A freediver in a black swimsuit and mask dives down through clear tropical water, swims to the sandy sea floor, picks up a dark stone from the bottom and surfaces to show it to the camera.

title: bow_105
transcript: Wow, that's tight! Aha! Dead center!
asset_description: In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.

title: aim_106
asset_description: In a mountain village field a young archer holds a tall bamboo bow at full draw, one eye down the shaft, holding steady on a distant hay bale for most of the clip before he lets the arrow go and follows its flight.

title: bowl_107
asset_description: A cartoon boy with glasses takes a blue bowl down from the kitchen cupboard, pours in cereal and milk, then lifts the bowl with both hands and drinks the last milk straight from it.

title: box_110
asset_description: In an empty flat, a young woman folds a flat sheet of cardboard into a big box, packs a rolled blanket, mugs and a plant into it with her partner, closes the lid, carries it and stacks three boxes; her cat jumps on top of the pile.

title: boxing_111
asset_description: A young woman in red boxing gloves trains in a gym: she punches her coach's pads next to the ring, works the heavy bag, hits the speed ball and laughs happily between rounds.

title: brave_112
transcript: It's coming! Run! Okay, my turn.
asset_description: In a cartoon park a big goose steals a family's picnic basket; while her parents cower behind the fence, a small red-haired girl clenches her fists, marches straight at the goose, stares it down and takes the basket back - then her parents lift her up like a champion with a trophy.

title: bread_114
asset_description: Two bakers pull a golden round loaf out of a wood-fired stone oven on a wooden peel, knock on the crust to check it, then tear the warm bread open with steam rising from the soft inside and taste it.

title: breakfast_115
asset_description: A couple in pajamas makes breakfast at sunrise: they fry eggs, butter the toast, drizzle honey on porridge with berries and pour orange juice, then carry it all outside and eat together at a garden table while a rooster struts by.

title: breaking_116
asset_description: A Pixar-style craftsman in goggles gleefully smashes blue ceramic tiles with a hammer, breaking a whole stack into small shards; he accidentally knocks a clay pot off the bench so it shatters too, then arranges the broken pieces into a colorful mosaic sun.

title: a_mosaic_117
asset_description: In a pottery studio a couple smash a cloth-wrapped stack of plates with a mallet, then a man in gloves picks the flat shards out of the cloth and presses them one by one into a clay square, building a flower pattern; at the end the pair hold up the finished tiled panel.

title: building_118
transcript: Hold it square, go! Dead level!
asset_description: A couple at a community garden builds a raised wooden planter: they hold the frame square, screw the boards together with a cordless drill, check the top with a spirit level, fill it with soil from a wheelbarrow and plant two seedlings, finishing with a high-five.

title: bulb_119
asset_description: In a cozy evening living room a man unscrews the dead bulb from a small table lamp, takes a new bulb out of its cardboard box, screws it in, and the lamp glows warmly while his partner watches from the sofa with tea and the cat looks on.

title: burger_120
transcript: Stack it high. Both hands worth it.
asset_description: At an outdoor evening grill a man fries a beef patty, melts cheese on it and stacks a tall burger with lettuce, tomato, sauce and onion rings; a young woman grabs it with both hands and takes big happy bites.

title: burn_121
asset_description: A 3D-animated man cooks a pancake in a smoking frying pan in his kitchen; when he tips the pan onto the plate the pancake is completely black and charred, and he stares at it in shock saying 'Oops'.

title: bus_stop_122
transcript: Ten more minutes! Fininally, here it comes!
asset_description: Three cartoon commuters wait impatiently under a bus-stop shelter on a foggy street; an orange double-decker bus finally pulls up, they board, and the bus drives off leaving the stop empty.

title: bush_123
asset_description: A woman picks blueberries from tall leafy bushes on a berry farm when a blackbird suddenly flutters out of the branches and startles her; a man joins her and they taste the berries together.

title: spread_124
asset_description: A 3D-animated girl saws a slab off an enormous block of butter and drags it across a slice of bread with a knife until the whole surface is covered in a glossy layer, then bites into it with her eyes closed in bliss.

asset_description: A woman shows a red ball to a golden retriever and throws it across the garden; the dog sprints after it under the apple tree, snaps it up in its mouth, trots the whole way back to her and drops it at her feet before rolling over for a belly rub.

title: dolphin_236
asset_description: Filmed from a boat, a sleek grey dolphin swims fast alongside the railing just under the surface of the deep blue sea. It then races ahead and leaps high out of the water several times, splashing back down tail-first.

title: donkey_237
asset_description: A grey donkey with long ears stands on a cobbled village street under an orange tree, staring at the camera and braying loudly with its mouth wide open. It then flops down, rolls happily on its back in the dust, gets up and trots toward the camera.

title: steal_238
asset_description: Doorbell camera footage shows a delivery man in a yellow hi-vis vest jogging up the path to drop off a package next to a crate of drink cans on the doorstep. Instead of just leaving it, he pulls a can out of the customer's pack for himself and sprints away down the path with it.

title: doubt_239
asset_description: At an outdoor flea market, a young man skeptically examines a gold ring an old woman seller is offering him. He turns it over, squints at it against the light, frowns, says he does not think so, and puts the ring back on the stall table unconvinced.

title: draw_240
asset_description: A woman and a burly man arm-wrestle fiercely at a kitchen table while the family and a grandma watch. Neither can push the other's hand down, and the match ends with both arms collapsing at the same time and everyone laughing as grandma lays a towel over their locked fists.

title: drawing_241
asset_description: An animated young man sits on stone steps in an Italian seaside town, sketching the pastel harbor houses in a spiral notebook. He pauses, erases a line, keeps shading, and finally holds up the finished pencil drawing next to the real view for an impressed passerby.

title: dress_242
transcript: All one piece? Whoa! Spin again!
asset_description: A red summer dress hangs on a hanger under a lemon tree while a hand points out that it is all one piece. A young woman then wears it in the courtyard, checks herself in a mirror and twirls so the skirt flares out while a man applauds.

title: dressing_243
asset_description: After a timer beep, a woman frantically pulls a sweater over her head, hair standing up with static, while her partner helps her into a scarf, jacket and beanie. She laces boots, checks the full winter outfit in the mirror and gets a thumbs up before hurrying out the door with her bag.

title: drink_244
asset_description: A thirsty man staggers up to a street fruit stand where a vendor squeezes oranges into a tall glass. He gulps the fresh juice down in one go, sighs with relief, and happily asks for another while a parrot watches from the stand.

title: drinking_245
asset_description: Two young hikers with backpacks take turns drinking from a steel bottle at a mountain hut, the woman gulping so fast she gasps. They refill the bottle at a stone fountain and drink again side by side at a railing in front of jagged Dolomite peaks.

title: driving_246
transcript: Easy through the bend. Smoothest park ever.
asset_description: From inside the car, a woman's hands guide the steering wheel along an empty coastal road, easing smoothly through a bend with the sea ahead. She parks, and her passenger turns around smiling to praise the smooth drive.

title: drop_247
asset_description: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an animated boy holds a red apple high in the air, opens his hand and lets it fall. The apple bounces on the paving stones and he bends over his knees to look down at where it landed.

title: dropper_248
transcript: One. Two. Steady. Three drops. That's enough. But better already.
asset_description: In an animated old apothecary, a woman squeezes the bulb of a glass dropper, draws up liquid and counts three drops into a wooden spoon. She hands the dose to a red-bearded man wrapped in a blanket, who takes it and immediately looks better.

title: duck_250
asset_description: A male mallard duck swims on a calm pond under willow trees, tips tail-up to feed underwater with its orange feet in the air, then pops back up. It rears out of the water flapping its wings, settles, and quacks at the camera.

title: dumbbell_251
asset_description: A young man grabs a black plate-loaded dumbbell from a yoga mat, does biceps curls with it and presses it overhead in the living room. His girlfriend watches from an armchair sipping coffee and applauds as he sets it down grinning.

title: dust_252
asset_description: In an old attic full of jars, a finger drags a clean stripe through the thick grey dust on a shelf and the hand comes up coated. A young man lifts an old suitcase and blows a huge cloud of dust off it into the sunbeams while his friend laughs and coughs.

title: dusting_253
asset_description: A couple gasps in mock horror at a finger swiped through the dust on their shelf. They dust the whole flat with cloth and duster - picture frame, lampshade, door frame - get a dust cloud in the face, and finish with exaggerated thumbs up over the spotless shelves while the cat climbs in.

title: earth_254
asset_description: By an open window above a coastal village, a young couple lean over a desk globe, spin it and stop it with a hand. They point at a spot on the little blue planet and grin at each other saying this is where they are, while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.

title: east_255
asset_description: Before dawn on a rocky summit, a woman wrapped in a blanket points to a thin red stripe on the horizon. A small group with warm drinks stands facing that side of the sky as the glow grows and the sun finally rises over the sea of clouds, and they cheer with raised arms.

title: eating_256
asset_description: A couple on tiny plastic stools at an Asian night-market stall lift noodles, greens and broth to their mouths from big soup bowls, slurping happily. They eat everything, the woman even drinks straight from the bowl, and both pat comically swollen full bellies at the end.

title: edge_258
transcript: Got it. Whoa. All the way.
asset_description: A hand slides along the rim of a wooden picnic table until the fingers stop right where the top ends. At a lakeside camp two people pull a rope to the corner of a tarp, and a blue-haired person walks carefully out a narrow dock, pointing down, until their toes stop at the very end above the water.

title: eerie_259
asset_description: A static night shot looks over a floodlit rail freight yard while a deep red glow pulses in the dark clouds on the horizon. The glow swells into a bright burning ball lighting the sky blood-red, then slowly shrinks and fades as wind howls over the scene.

title: egg_260
transcript: Shell not again The deep gold
asset_description: A young man's first egg crumbles and he grumbles while picking shell bits out of the bowl, his cat watching from the window. He cracks a fresh egg into a buttered pan, fries it sunny-side up, slides it onto toast and dips the bread into the runny golden yolk, eating with yolk on his chin.
speech_sentences: Shell not again The deep gold

title: electrician_261
asset_description: During a blackout, a woman in a hard hat and hi-vis vest works on an open fuse box in a dark hallway while a family lights the scene with phone flashlights. She snips wires, fits a new breaker and flips it, the lights come back on and everyone cheers.

title: elephant_262
asset_description: A large African elephant stands at a waterhole among white egrets, drinking with its trunk, splashing mud and spraying water over itself. It finishes facing the camera with ears spread wide and trunk raised.

title: emerge_263
asset_description: A calm hand-painted mountain lake lies still until a splash breaks the surface and a swimmer in a teal cap and goggles bursts up out of the water. She lifts her goggles, grins and throws her arms up in triumph.

title: emotion_264
asset_description: A young woman waits at airport arrivals clutching yellow flowers, and when a man pushes his luggage trolley through the doors she covers her mouth and bursts into tears. She runs to him and they hug tightly, both laughing and crying at once.

title: employee_265
transcript: Great month, Kenji. Thank you, boss! Payday! Let's go!
asset_description: In a night-time office a young worker with a badge lanyard hauls stacks of papers through his tasks as the clock spins. His silver-haired boss pats his shoulder, shakes his hand and hands him a pay envelope, and he celebrates with a coworker.

title: energy_266
asset_description: At an outdoor group workout a woman powers through burpees and star jumps, sprints up and down a long flight of stone steps and does box jumps while others catch their breath. She keeps bouncing and laughing while the rest of the group slumps over exhausted.

title: engineer_267
asset_description: In an electronics lab a young man in glasses assembles a small robotic arm, tightens parts and types code on a laptop. The arm picks up a white cube and places it in a tray, and he pumps his fist while colleagues in lab coats applaud.

title: envelope_268
asset_description: By candlelight two women fold a handwritten letter and slide it into a cream paper envelope. They drip red sealing wax on the flap, press a stamp into it and admire the sealed envelope, one giving it a kiss.

title: envy_269
asset_description: A young woman stuck on a crowded bus with a rusty old handlebar across her lap stares out the window at a cyclist gliding past on a nice bike. She sighs 'I want that', presses her hand against the glass and slumps back with a long envious look.

title: eraser_270
transcript: Look at my cute eraser. I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain. So pretty.
asset_description: A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.
speech_sentences: I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain.

title: evaporate_272
asset_description: On a rooftop at sunset a cartoon woman with goggles heats a pan of water on a camping stove. The shallow puddle of water shrinks, vanishes in a puff of steam and she flips the pan over to show it is completely empty and dry.

title: evening_273
asset_description: A couple stands at a wall above a small town clinking mugs as the sun sinks behind the hills. The sky slowly darkens from orange sunset to deep blue dusk, the town lights come on and the moon brightens above them.

title: everyone_274
asset_description: In a packed football stadium a fan with a painted face and rainbow scarf screams with joy, and the camera pulls back over the stands. Every single person in the huge crowd is on their feet cheering with raised arms at the same moment.

title: excursion_276
asset_description: A group of friends with backpacks loads into a minibus and rides through green sheep-dotted countryside, pointing out the window. They park, hike a woodland path to a big waterfall and pose together for a phone group photo in front of it.

title: exercise_277
transcript: I do my exercise every day. It is good for me.
asset_description: In a sunny garden a woman in workout clothes goes through her routine: jumping jacks, jogging on the spot, toe touches and side stretches. She finishes facing the camera with a big smile and two thumbs up, saying she does her exercise every day.
speech_sentences: I do my exercise every day.

title: a_squat_278
asset_description: At sunrise in a park a mixed group of young and older people stand in rows on the grass and drop together into a deep knee bend with hips down and hands at the chest, coming back up and repeating it in time before moving on to lunges and arm raises.

title: exert_279
asset_description: A muscular anime villager strains every muscle to push a heavy cart loaded with sacks up a steep cobbled street, sweat flying and feet slipping on wet stones. He collapses onto the handle, then grits his teeth and raises a determined fist to keep going.

title: a_kitten_280
asset_description: A tiny orange tabby kitten with huge round eyes sits on a bed and stares straight into the camera. It tilts its head, then reaches out a paw and bats at the lens until its face fills the whole frame in a blurry extreme close-up.

title: eyeliner_281
transcript: (snaps) Oh, nailed it. (laughs) - No one's flying. (upbeat music)
asset_description: A young woman leans close to a bathroom mirror and carefully draws a black winged line along her upper eyelid with an eyeliner pen while a friend watches behind her. She finishes the wing, celebrates, and tidies the edge with a cotton swab, getting a thumbs up.

title: eyeshadow_282
transcript: Liquid gold. Ooh, look at that.
asset_description: Close-up of a makeup palette as a brush picks up shimmery gold eyeshadow, then pats and blends it over a woman's eyelid until the whole lid sparkles gold. She then admires the finished golden lids with a friend on camera.

title: fabric_283
asset_description: In a shop stacked with colorful wax-print cloth, a woman picks a patterned roll and the seller unrolls it across a wooden table. She feels the material between her fingers, he measures and cuts two meters, and she hugs her folded piece happily.

title: face_mask_284
transcript: Don't make me laugh. It's cracking!
asset_description: At a cozy pajama night, a woman spreads thick green clay from a bowl over her friend's face with a spatula. The two sit with matching green face masks; the dried masks crack as one starts laughing and warns the other not to make her laugh.

title: family_285
transcript: Everybody, together now... Move up, move up! Cheese!
asset_description: In a 2D cartoon, a grandpa sets a camera on a tripod in the yard while a big multi-generation family gathers on the porch at dinner. He starts the timer, hurries over to join grandma, parents, kids and the dog, and the camera flashes for the group photo.

title: far_287
asset_description: Three hikers stand on an endless flat steppe while one shields her eyes and points at a tiny settlement on the horizon. They keep walking toward it, and wide shots show them as small dots with the village still far away in the distance.

title: fashion_288
asset_description: Two models in elegant oversized suits, one cream and one taupe, pose and twirl for a phone photographer on a Paris street. They adjust their jackets, strut past cafe terraces like on a runway, and a little dog in a sweater trots along with them.

title: fear_289
asset_description: A young woman on a glass skywalk high above a mountain canyon freezes in terror, gripping the railing with wide eyes and saying she can't go on. She clutches her chest, then crouches down hugging the rail post, too scared to look through the see-through floor, while a friend walks up behind her.

title: feeling_290
asset_description: In a crowded football fan pub, a woman watches a match with her hand pressed to her chest, going from nervous dread to closed-eyed tension. When the goal comes she erupts, screaming with joy and near tears as the whole bar celebrates around her.

title: field_291
asset_description: A golden wheat field stretches to the horizon at sunset as a couple walks down a narrow path through it. They brush their hands over the ripe wheat, hold up a single stalk against the sun, and the woman runs laughing along the path between the tall rows.

title: fight_292
asset_description: A young couple stands on a bed in a sunny attic bedroom and starts a pillow fight, swinging and blocking with big white pillows. A pillow bursts, feathers explode everywhere, and they collapse laughing on the feather-covered bed, one conceding that the other wins.

title: filmmaking_293
asset_description: On a rooftop at sunset, a small film crew shoots a scene: an actress stands by a light reflector while the director crouches at a camera on a tripod, a boom mic hangs overhead and a clapperboard snaps before the take. Afterwards the whole crew gathers behind the monitor and celebrates the shot.

title: fire_294
asset_description: At dusk by a forest lake, a couple sits around a stone-ringed campfire roasting marshmallows on long sticks. One drops a fresh log onto the flames, the fire flares up and a big cloud of orange sparks rises into the evening sky as they watch in awe.

title: mix_295
asset_description: First-person view into a blue bucket as a hand folds and stirs thick pale joint compound with a putty knife. The paste is scooped, turned and smoothed over and over until it looks creamy, in a slow oddly satisfying rhythm.

title: fish_296
transcript: From the sea! Look! White! It flakes!
asset_description: On a beach at sunset, a man grills a whole fish in a wire basket over glowing coals next to a fishing boat, then squeezes lemon over it. A woman lifts a flaky white piece with a fork, tastes it and closes her eyes with delight.

title: fishing_297
asset_description: A couple sits on a wooden dock at a mirror-calm forest lake with a fishing rod out. The rod bends, they reel in and scoop a silvery trout with a landing net, admire it together, then gently release it back into the water and high-five.

title: fitting_room_298
asset_description: In a clothes shop, a woman disappears behind a fitting room curtain and steps out in one outfit after another: a khaki jumpsuit that gets a thumbs down from her bored friend, a red dress, and finally a green jumpsuit that wins an excited thumbs up.

title: wake_up_299
asset_description: A fixed night camera shows a woman fast asleep in bed when her dog jumps up, paces over the blanket and nudges and licks her face. She stirs, sits up rubbing her eyes and hides her face laughing while the excited dog stands over her wanting to play.

title: flag_300
asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a girl in a red parka stands by a stone hut on a snowy mountain and pulls the rope of a flagpole with her mittens. A folded teal flag rises up the pole, unfurls with a white stripe and golden sun, and she salutes it proudly as it waves against the peaks.

title: float_301
asset_description: A bearded man in blue swim shorts lies on his back on a calm mountain lake, arms spread wide, floating peacefully. A small yellow bird lands on his belly and then his head, and he grins and gives a thumbs up.

title: flour_302
transcript: Let it snow! Got you! Classic!
asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a man scoops white flour, sifts it over a wooden table like snow, presses handprints into it, then kneads it with water into dough. He ends up with flour on his nose and face and jokes about it with a woman while a dog watches.

title: flower_303
transcript: This flower is for you. I give you a pretty flower.
asset_description: A red-haired woman in a mustard sweater sits by a window holding a paper-wrapped bouquet of pink and white flowers. She touches a pink rose, then holds a single pink daisy-like flower up to the camera and by her face, saying she gives you a pretty flower.
speech_sentences: I give you a pretty flower.

title: fly_305
asset_description: At a sunny breakfast table, a black fly buzzes around a glass of tea and lands on a slice of toast spread with red jam. A hand waves a napkin to chase it away, and the fly circles back to perch on the jam jar and the tea glass.

title: flying_306
transcript: We're up! We're up! Look, a whole sky ocean.
asset_description: A young couple sits at an airplane window during takeoff, pointing excitedly as the runway drops away and fields shrink below. The plane climbs through clouds, and above a golden sea of clouds at sunset they press their hands to the window and cheer, saying they are up in a whole sky ocean.

title: fog_307
asset_description: A woman in a red beanie and a man in a dark jacket play hide-and-seek in a foggy field by a stone wall. The man walks off into the thick fog until he disappears completely and she calls 'Where are you?', then he runs back out of the mist yelling 'Boo!' as a sheep appears nearby.

title: food_308
asset_description: At a long wooden table in a stone-walled courtyard, friends share a big spread of food: fresh flatbread torn open, steaming meat stew ladled onto plates, dumplings, white cheese, grapes and pomegranates. They dip bread in the stew, pass plates around and eat together, saying 'So much, look! Dig in!'

title: football_309
asset_description: Young people play barefoot football on a beach at sunset. A woman in a green shirt dribbles past defenders in the sand and shoots at a goal by the water; the keeper dives and shouts 'No way!' as the ball flies past. She drops to her knees celebrating and her friends pile on her in a hug.

title: forest_310
asset_description: A red-haired woman and a young man walk from a green meadow in among huge tall trees. Deep inside the woods they tilt their heads back to stare up at the towering trunks as sunbeams cut through the mist, spread their arms wide and say 'Oh wow, so nice.'

title: fork_311
transcript: Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.
asset_description: At a candlelit restaurant table, a woman holds a silver fork up to the camera, then twirls a huge coil of spaghetti onto it while her date watches wide-eyed. She proudly lifts the loaded fork, eats the pasta, and then spears salad leaves and a cherry tomato with it, saying 'Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.'

title: foul_312
asset_description: In an indoor futsal match, a player in orange dribbles the ball and a defender in purple grabs and trips her from behind. The referee blows the whistle, raises her arm and points for a free kick while the guilty player protests with his hands up.

title: foundation_313
asset_description: At a bright vanity by a window, a friend helps a young woman with dots of foundation on her cheek, blending them into her skin with a makeup sponge. The camera shows her evenly covered face turning from side to side, and both smile into the round mirror next to bottles of foundation, saying 'That one gone, so smooth.'

title: fox_314
asset_description: A red fox with a white chest and bushy tail trots through a frosty autumn meadow between birch trees at sunrise. It walks toward the camera, then does its signature high pounce, diving head-first into the frosty grass to catch something, and shakes itself off.

title: free_kick_315
asset_description: On a pitch at sunset a player in maroon places the ball on the line while a wall of defenders in black lines up in front of the goal. He runs up and curls the free kick over the wall; the goalkeeper dives but the ball flies in, and the taker slides on his knees celebrating while the wall curses.

title: freezer_316
transcript: Look! You can see the cold! Rock solid!
asset_description: In a wooden cabin kitchen, a woman pulls open the bottom freezer drawer of a fridge and icy mist pours out, making her gasp 'You can see the cold!'. She lifts out a rock-solid bag of frozen peas, a man taps a tub of ice cream with a spoon, and they show a bag of frost-covered berries before closing the drawer.

title: french_fries_317
transcript: Easy. In they go. Crispy! Perfect!
asset_description: At an outdoor food stand by a canal, a vendor lowers a basket of pale potato sticks into bubbling oil. He lifts out golden crispy fries, fills a white paper cone, sprinkles salt over them, and a customer in a beanie blows on a hot fry and eats it with delight, saying 'Crispy! Perfect!'

title: friendship_318
transcript: Hey! Bad day? The worst. Here. Half for you. You're the best!
asset_description: A cartoon girl sits sadly on a boardwalk next to her dropped ice cream cone. Her friend arrives with a fresh ice cream, sits beside her, asks 'Bad day?' and gives her half. They share the ice cream, high-five, cheer up and walk off into the sunset with an arm around each other.

title: frog_319
asset_description: A green frog sits on a mossy stone in a koi pond covered with lily pads under red maple leaves. It puffs out its white throat as it croaks, then leaps through the air and lands on a floating lily pad while orange koi fish swim below.

title: frost_320
asset_description: On a freezing sunrise morning, boots crunch over grass coated white with frost as a couple walks through a garden leaving dark footprints. They admire a frosty spiderweb, wipe an icy layer off a white bench, show a leaf edged in ice crystals and draw a line in the frost with a finger, saying 'Cool, cool, cool.'

title: fruit_321
asset_description: A young woman at an open-air market stall admires a mango, hanging bananas and grapes, fills her basket with a pineapple and oranges, then happily bites into a peach saying it is juicy.

title: gambling_322
asset_description: In a 3D-animated casino, a woman in a green suit slams a tower of chips onto red at a spinning wheel; she and a nervous man despair as the wheel lands, then she wins a huge pile of chips and celebrates wildly.

title: game_323
asset_description: Friends play a pickup basketball game on an outdoor court at sunset; a red-haired woman dribbles past defenders, the ball drops through the hoop and her team hugs and cheers.

title: gaming_324
asset_description: In an anime-style living room at night, a pink-haired girl and a guy in a red varsity jacket battle with game controllers; he panics while she wins and throws her fist up cheering.

title: garden_326
asset_description: A woman in an apron tours her backyard garden at sunset: she waters lettuce beds, picks a ripe tomato by the greenhouse, shells fresh peas into her palm and smells the pink roses.

title: gardening_327
transcript: There, grow well. Still warm from the sun.
asset_description: A man in gloves does gardening in a raised bed: he digs a hole, un-pots a seedling, plants and waters it, then later picks a ripe tomato, bites into it and high-fives his gardening partner.

title: garlic_328
transcript: Smash skins off. That smell incredible.
asset_description: A woman in a kitchen smashes a garlic bulb with her palm, breaks it into cloves and peels one; she sniffs it, winces at the strong smell, then drops it into a pan of hot oil and she and her partner sniff the delicious steam.

title: gas_329
asset_description: A couple at an old white stove turns the knob and the gas burner lights with a blue flame; they watch it burn, set a kettle on it, then start frying red onions in an oiled pan over the flame.

title: gate_330
transcript: Am I too late? Just in time. Go go! Thank you!
asset_description: In a 3D-animated airport, a girl with a rolling suitcase sprints across the terminal to the boarding gate asking if she is too late; the smiling agent scans her pass just in time and she runs down the jet bridge onto the plane, waving back.

title: gentleman_331
transcript: Allow me, madam. After you, please. Oh, how kind!
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime street in the rain, a mustached man in a suit kneels to gather an old lady's spilled oranges, shelters her under his umbrella, opens the cafe door for her with "After you, please" and tips his hat as she thanks him.

title: giraffe_332
asset_description: On a sunny savanna with zebras in the background, a giraffe stretches its long neck to eat leaves from the top of an acacia tree, then splays its front legs wide to drink from a small waterhole.

title: girl_333
transcript: (bell ringing) - Hump, hump, two foot stretch, hump. Yes! (cheering)
asset_description: On a school playground, a girl with yellow ribbons in her pigtails skips rope, hops through a chalk hopscotch grid and jumps in a hula hoop while other girls watch; at the end she throws her arms up and her friends run in for a group hug.
speech_sentences: Hump, hump, two foot stretch, hump.

title: glass_334
transcript: I can see you! Ah, ice cold!
asset_description: On a sunny tiled terrace, a woman peers through an empty glass joking "I can see you!", fills it with ice cubes and fresh lemonade, hooks a lemon slice on the rim and drinks; she and a friend clink their glasses.

title: glasses_336
asset_description: On a park bench by a duck pond, a squinting red-haired woman guesses there are three ducks, then cleans her round glasses with a cloth, puts them on and gasps that there are actually seven.

title: globe_338
transcript: Look at my globe! A globe is a small round earth. I spin the globe and I can see every country! Can you believe this?
asset_description: In a cozy study, a curly-haired woman excitedly shows off the desk globe next to her lamp, spins it fast, stops it with a finger to point out countries, then hugs the globe to the camera.
speech_sentences: A globe is a small round earth.
I spin the globe and I can see every country!

title: go_339
asset_description: In a 3D-animated town, a girl in a red raincoat steps out of a blue door with her bag, waves "Bye! See you!" to her mother and goes off down the colorful cobblestone street.

title: goal_340
asset_description: Friends carry a white goal frame onto a cobblestone town square and set it up; a young man dribbles and kicks the ball past the diving keeper into the goal, and the players jump and celebrate while two old men watch from a bench.

title: goat_341
asset_description: A brown-and-white goat with long horns climbs onto a stone wall in a village yard, chews laundry hanging from a clothesline, then walks up onto a rooftop and bleats loudly at the sky.

title: goggles_342
transcript: Strap on! Nice and tight! Now I can see! Ha! Two big circles!
asset_description: An animated girl at an indoor pool straps blue swim goggles over her eyes, gives a thumbs up to her coach, then dives in and swims underwater wearing them.

title: grab_343
asset_description: A woman in a pool pulls her mask on, gives a thumbs up and dives; she swims down to a ring lying on the blue tiles, closes her fingers round it and snatches it up, then shoots to the surface holding it above her head.

title: gold_344
asset_description: An animated jeweler in a plum suit lifts a heavy gold bar onto her counter, polishes it until it shines and admires her reflection in it, then drapes a gold chain and slips on gold bangles, hugging the bar possessively.

title: golf_346
asset_description: On a links course at sunset a woman chips the ball onto the green, lines up a putt beside the flagstick, and the ball rolls in; she and her caddie throw their arms up and celebrate.

title: gossip_347
transcript: She told me everything. No way! Don't look now. I'm not looking!
asset_description: Two animated friends at an outdoor cafe table whisper into each other's ears with shocked faces, sneak glances at an old couple at a nearby table while saying they are not looking, then sip their coffee innocently.

title: government_348
transcript: All in favor? Yes. Good. It is done.
asset_description: In a cartoon state boardroom a grey-haired leader in a purple suit points at a chart, calls a vote and stern ministers in suits raise their hands, then she presses an official seal onto a decree and the cabinet shakes hands.

title: grandfather_349
asset_description: A white-bearded old man in a cap spends the day with his young grandson: they reel in a fish on a lake dock, finish a wooden birdhouse in his workshop, and play chess in a park before he hugs the boy.

title: grandson_350
transcript: Mom, look who came. Oh, my boy's boy. Hi, Gran.
asset_description: An animated young man with a backpack arrives at the family house at night; his father welcomes him at the door and calls to the tiny grandmother in her armchair, who reaches up, cups her grown grandson's face and hugs him.

title: grass_351
asset_description: Two barefoot teenagers stand on a freshly mown striped lawn, try to whistle through blades of grass held between their thumbs, laugh, then flop down and stretch out side by side on the soft green lawn.

title: grill_352
transcript: Two seconds, ready? The stripes, look!

title: milk_478
transcript: Pour it all. The moustache classic.
asset_description: In a farmhouse kitchen with green fields outside, a woman opens a glass bottle of fresh milk and pours it into a tall glass. She gulps it all down and turns around wearing a huge white milk moustache, then she and a man clink their glasses, both sporting milk moustaches, while a cat laps milk from a bowl.

title: mind_479
transcript: You've got nothing! Wait, let me think. All up here. No!
asset_description: In a Pixar-style autumn park, a girl plays chess against a taunting opponent. She taps her temple, closes her eyes, and a thought bubble over her head shows the board with her moves planned as dotted lines. She calmly plays the winning move and smiles smugly as the opponent slumps in defeat.

title: mineral_water_480
asset_description: At a cafe table by a fountain, a woman twists the cap off a green glass bottle of mineral water and pours it fizzing over ice into a glass. She listens to the bubbles, sips, giggles at the tickle, and pours a glass for her friend so they can clink and drink together.

title: mirror_481
asset_description: A young man in a gym flexes and poses in front of the big wall mirror, moving in sync with his reflection like a game. Friends in yellow and purple shirts gather around and everyone flexes at the mirror, laughing.

title: monkey_483
asset_description: A macaque monkey climbs a huge banyan tree by a mossy temple, swings along a branch and hangs upside down by its tail. It drops onto a fruit seller's table, grabs a banana while the man waves his hat at it, then sits on a branch peeling and eating the banana.

title: mop_484
asset_description: In an animated late-night diner, a waitress dunks a mop into a red bucket, wrings it out dripping, and mops the checkered floor between stacked chairs. She nearly slips on the wet tiles, catches herself, and finally leans on the mop admiring the shiny clean floor.

title: moss_485
asset_description: In a misty forest full of green-covered boulders, two people press their hands into the thick springy moss on a rock, leaving hand prints that slowly spring back. One squeezes a wet clump of moss so water drips out, then a woman rests her cheek on the soft mossy rock like a pillow.

title: mountain_486
transcript: Oh wow, the valley floor dropped away dramatically.
asset_description: A drone view shows a huge snow-capped mountain with a zigzag trail climbing through forest. Then a hiker's point of view walks over rocky ground above a sea of clouds, and finally two hikers stand on the snowy summit raising their trekking poles in celebration.
speech_sentences: Oh wow, the valley floor dropped away dramatically.

title: mouse_487
asset_description: In a warm-lit wooden barn at night, a little grey mouse peeks out of a hole in the wall and creeps toward a piece of cheese on the floorboards. It sits up, nibbles the cheese held in its tiny pink paws, then scurries back into the hole with its tail sliding in last.

title: muscle_488
asset_description: In a gym, a skinny red-haired teen flexes his thin arms and groans at how small they look. A fit woman steps in and flexes visibly bigger biceps next to him, then a huge bearded bodybuilder flexes enormous muscles while the teen's jaw drops in shock.

title: mushroom_489
asset_description: In an autumn forest, a couple with a wicker basket crouches over the leaf-covered ground where the woman points out a cluster of brown mushrooms with dewy caps. They then find a bright red mushroom with white spots glowing in the sunbeams and marvel at it without picking it, while a squirrel darts past.

title: musician_490
asset_description: On a cobblestone street at sunset, a red-haired young busker strums an acoustic guitar and sings to a circle of people. The crowd films him with their phones and applauds, and his open guitar case with coins lies at his feet.

title: mustard_491
transcript: Ooh, sharp! Sweet and sharp, wow!
asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a man tastes a spoonful of bright yellow mustard from a stone bowl and winces at its sharp taste. He whisks the mustard with honey into a glaze, brushes it over a tray of carrots, and a woman tastes the result and reacts with delighted surprise.

title: nail_polish_492
asset_description: At a sunny patio table with iced drinks, a woman shakes a bottle of coral nail polish, opens it and carefully paints her fingernails with the little brush. She blows on the wet nails and waves her hand stiffly, refusing to touch anything while her friend teases her.

title: nature_495
asset_description: A couple climbs over a wooden fence and walks through a green alpine meadow toward a clear stony stream. They quietly watch two deer grazing on the far bank, then lie down side by side in the wildflower grass gazing up at the sky.

title: necklace_496
asset_description: On a terrace full of pink flowers, a young woman holds up a colorful beaded necklace of red, blue and yellow strands. Her friends help her slip it over her head onto her white shirt, and she admires it in a small hand mirror, delighted.

title: nervous_498
asset_description: Backstage in the dark wings, a young musician with an acoustic guitar peeks through the curtain at the bright stage. He gulps water, breathes with wide anxious eyes and a hand on his chest, and when the stage manager points him on, he steels himself and walks out in front of the crowd.

title: newspaper_499
transcript: The whole world's in here! Peek-a-boo!
asset_description: At an outdoor cafe table with coffee and a croissant, a woman opens a huge broadsheet newspaper that completely hides her face. Her boyfriend leans over as she plays peek-a-boo from behind the pages, then she folds the newspaper up neatly and they leave together laughing.

title: dribble_500
transcript: Oh my head! No way, no way! He's gone!
asset_description: On a floodlit caged pitch at night, a player in a white hoodie dribbles a football toward a defender in teal. He beats him with quick skill touches, sprints away with the ball at his feet and finishes by shooting into the small goal.

title: night_501
asset_description: A young couple walks home through a quiet whitewashed village street at night under the moon and street lamps, a black cat trailing them. They say good night at a blue door and the man walks off alone down the dark lane.

title: north_502
transcript: There. It stopped. This way? Straight ahead. Come on. [whistling] [music playing]
asset_description: Two cartoon hikers in winter parkas stand in a rocky arctic landscape and check a golden compass whose needle settles on N. The woman points the way, and they hike off toward mountains under the northern lights.

title: notebook_503
asset_description: Two young women sit at a desk with pens and washi tape; one unwraps a brand-new mint-green notebook and flips through its blank pages. She then writes the first line in it with a pen while her friend claps excitedly.

title: nut_505
asset_description: A couple sits at a wooden garden table in autumn with a bowl of walnuts. The man cracks one open with a metal nutcracker, shows the two shell halves with the kernel inside, and they both snack on the nuts happily.

title: nutrition_506
asset_description: Two runners in sportswear build a colorful healthy plate in a kitchen: spinach, oats, tomato slices, avocado, berries, eggs and nuts arranged in rings. They taste it, celebrate, and jog out the door with their packs.

title: observe_507
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a girl crouches by a grassy stream and holds a magnifying glass up to a dragonfly perched on a cattail. She watches it closely and intently, then smiles at what she sees.

title: ocean_508
asset_description: From the deck of a sailboat, endless deep-blue water stretches to the horizon under a clear sky. Dolphins leap out of the waves beside the boat while the crew in sailing jackets points and cheers.

title: oil_509
asset_description: In a sunny Greek-style kitchen, golden olive oil is poured slowly from a bottle into a dish, pooling in circles. Tomato slices are laid in the oil, and a couple dips chunks of fresh bread into a small bowl of it and eats with delight.

title: onion_511
asset_description: A man peels a white onion, halves it on a cutting board and starts slicing, but his eyes water and he wipes tears while a woman behind him cries too. He then puts on blue swim goggles, gives a thumbs up, and happily finishes chopping the onion.

title: outfit_512
asset_description: A young woman and a guy lay clothes out on a bed, swapping pieces: a rust jacket, a cream blouse, dark jeans traded for cream trousers, white sneakers and a straw hat. She then wears the finished combination and checks herself in the mirror while he cheers.

title: outside_513
asset_description: On a sunny savanna, a family carries their table, chairs, a woven mat and a big pot of food out of their small house onto the grass. They set everything up in the open air and sit down to eat together in front of the house.

title: oven_514
asset_description: A young couple slides a tray of raw bread dough into a kitchen oven and crouches at the glass door, watching the light inside as the loaf rises and turns golden. Wearing oven mitts, they pull out the finished brown loaf, thrilled.

title: overcome_515
asset_description: In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.

title: overflow_516
asset_description: In a cel-animated kitchen, a man fills the sink to wash dishes but looks away, and the foamy water rises over the rim and pours onto the floor. He rushes back to shut the tap and stands sheepishly in a big puddle.

title: overtake_517
asset_description: In a cel-animated desert highway scene, a red sports car pulls alongside a slow beige camper van, speeds past it and swings in front. The camper shrinks in the distance while the grinning driver whoops and races ahead.

title: owl_518
asset_description: An extreme close-up of a huge orange eye pulls back to reveal a grey owl staring into the camera. It perches on a branch at dusk, swiveling its head, then spreads its wings and flies off toward the sunset over the forest.

title: pack_519
transcript: I pack my bag for school. I put my books, my bottle, and my pens inside.
asset_description: Hands fill an empty beige tote bag laid on a bed: a pink water bottle goes into a side pocket, then notebooks and books, a pencil pouch and earphones each find their place. The full bag is zipped up and lifted by its straps, ready to go.
speech_sentences: I pack my bag for school.
I put my books, my bottle, and my pens inside.

title: paddle_520
asset_description: A smiling girl in a life jacket dips a wooden paddle into a calm green river and strokes on both sides of a canoe, gliding past bamboo and orange cliffs. A man in a sun hat lies dozing in the bow and gets a few drips on his face as she paddles over him.

title: pain_521
asset_description: A barefoot young man carrying a laundry basket stubs his toe on a metal bed frame, drops the laundry, cries out and sits on the floor clutching his hurt foot.

title: painting_522
transcript: Big, bold, blue. Better than the real one.
asset_description: On a sunny Santorini terrace, a young woman at an easel mixes blue paint and paints a seascape of the coast in front of her, then smiles and presents the finished painting, joking it is better than the real view.

title: pan_523
transcript: Little one first! The big door!
asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a man in an apron oils a steel frying pan, adds sliced peppers and onion, tosses the vegetables high in the pan while a woman watches amazed, then slides them onto a plate.

title: panic_524
asset_description: On a metro platform a young woman with blue hair frantically pats her pockets, dumps her tote bag on the ground to search through keys, wallet and phone, then rushes at the closing train doors and grabs her head in wide-eyed despair as the train leaves.

title: paperclip_525
transcript: The pages catch! Holds even now!
asset_description: In an office a desk fan blows sheets off a paper stack while two coworkers scramble; the woman takes a paperclip from a glass dish, clips the stack together, and the papers now hold even in front of the fan as they celebrate.

title: paralyze_526
asset_description: In a cartoon workshop a young scientist fires a ray gun at a man in a green tracksuit; he freezes mid-step with a glowing outline, stuck rigid in one pose while she waves at him and tests him, and he finally tips over stiff as a board into her arms.

title: parcel_527
asset_description: A courier in a yellow vest hands a surprised red-haired woman a brown paper parcel tied with string at her garden gate; she carries it to the front door, shakes it curiously while a man watches, then opens the box and pulls out the tissue-wrapped contents excitedly.

title: park_528
asset_description: In a colorful cartoon beach town a young woman carefully steers her teal car into a street parking space between two cars, turns the key off, and steps out beaming while a man on the curb applauds her neat parking.

title: parrot_530
asset_description: A bright red scarlet macaw perches on a wooden porch railing in front of tropical flowers and banana leaves, flaps a wing, preens its yellow-and-blue feathers, tilts its head and squawks Hello at the camera.

title: party_531
asset_description: At sunset a group of friends holds a garden party with bunting, balloons, a snack table and lemonade; they dance on the grass with a dog running around, throw confetti and raise their cups in a toast.

title: pass_532
asset_description: On a paved plaza in a colorful mountain town, players in teal shirts play street football against a defender; the man passes the ball to his teammate, she takes it, shoots at the small goal and the two celebrate with a hug.

title: passport_533
asset_description: In a cartoon airport a woman in a pink jacket hands her blue passport to a border officer, who flips through the stamped pages, checks her photo against her big grin, stamps a page and gives it back; she kisses the passport and rolls her suitcase through the gate.

title: pasta_535
transcript: Find it! In they go! Now twirl it!
asset_description: In an Italian kitchen a chef fans dry spaghetti into a big pot, boils and tastes it, lifts the strands with tongs into a pan of tomato sauce, then serves a tall twirled tower of pasta on a plate that a woman happily slurps.

title: peace_536
asset_description: A young woman in linen pajamas steps onto a tropical veranda at sunrise, sets a mug of coffee on a stool, settles into a rope hammock among palm trees and relaxes with closed eyes while an orange cat climbs onto her lap.

title: peel_537
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene a girl with a braid sits on a porch above green fields and peels a red apple with a small knife in one long unbroken spiral that drops into a basket, then holds up the fully peeled pale apple.

title: pen_538
transcript: Look at my pen. This pen is so cool. I click the pen and I write in many colors.
