asset_description: A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.
speech_sentences: I click the pen and I write in many colors.

title: penalty_540
asset_description: On a sun-baked pitch a referee points to the spot; a player in orange places the ball on the penalty mark, takes a run-up and shoots past the diving green goalkeeper, then her whole team mobs her in celebration.

title: pencil_541
asset_description: A young woman in a beret sketches a mountain landscape with a yellow pencil in an open notebook at a sunny wooden table, while a bearded man watches and applauds her finished drawing.

title: penguin_542
asset_description: A gentoo penguin waddles across Antarctic snow toward the camera, flops onto its belly to slide down the ice, then dives into the sea and swims underwater past the ice edge.

title: pepper_543
transcript: (upbeat music) Grind, grind, grind. Ah, ah. (laughs)
asset_description: A man in a bright kitchen grinds black pepper from a tall wooden pepper mill over a bowl of creamy pasta, then the pepper tickles his nose and he sneezes into his elbow before laughing and presenting the dish.

title: performance_545
asset_description: Two street performers juggle colorful clubs inside a chalk circle on a cobblestone old-town square, tossing clubs high while a large crowd rings them, watches and applauds, and the pair finally bow beside their tip hat.

title: perfume_546
transcript: Smells amazing. Too much, too much.
asset_description: In an ornate Moroccan-style courtyard at night, a young woman sprays perfume from a small amber bottle onto her wrist and neck, then playfully sprays big clouds of it at her friend, who laughs, waves the mist away and finally gives a thumbs up.

title: phone_547
asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a phone rings on a wooden table while two young women drink tea; one grabs it excitedly, answers the call and paces around chatting happily with her hand pressed to her cheek.

title: photography_548
transcript: Three, two, hold! That one! That one!
asset_description: At golden hour in a narrow cobblestone street, a young woman directs a man posing against a sunlit wall, shoots him with a large camera, then the two lean over the camera screen together, pointing at the shots and celebrating the best one.

title: piercing_549
transcript: Four tiny holes. New ring day.
asset_description: At a mirror with vanity lights, a young woman points to the small piercing holes in her ear, picks a gold hoop from a jewelry tray, fits it into an ear piercing and admires the rings in her ear with a thumbs up.

title: pig_550
asset_description: A big pink pig rolls happily in a muddy patch on a sunny farmyard, gets up, roots in the dirt with its snout, trots across the yard and drinks from a metal bucket while a farmer watches by the fence.

title: pigeon_551
asset_description: A grey pigeon struts between cafe chairs on a cobblestone city square, pecks around with other pigeons near a fountain, then flies up and lands on a terracotta rooftop.

title: pitch_553
asset_description: A groundskeeper in a flat cap mows the striped grass of a stadium football pitch, checks the fresh white lines with his boot, plants the yellow corner flag and stands proudly with crossed arms while players train in the background.

title: place_554
asset_description: A young woman carries a rolled mat along a wide tropical beach, scans the shore for the right spot, announces she has found it, unrolls the mat under a white umbrella and sits down facing the sea.

title: plant_555
transcript: Look at that! A new one!
asset_description: In a bright plant-filled apartment, a woman waters a potted plant with a gold watering can, wipes its big green leaves with a cloth, then she and a man excitedly point at a fresh new leaf shooting up from a pot while a cat watches.

title: plaster_556
transcript: Ow! Tiny cut! I've got this. All wrapped up.
asset_description: A red-haired woman winces and shows a cut finger in a kitchen; a man opens a small first-aid tin, peels the backing off an adhesive plaster, wraps it around her fingertip and playfully blows on the bandaged finger.

title: plate_557
asset_description: A chef polishes a large white plate with a cloth, twirls spaghetti in tomato sauce onto its center with tongs, adds basil and a ring of olive oil, wipes the rim clean and proudly serves the plate to a delighted woman at a candlelit table.

title: play_558
asset_description: An animated group of friends plays volleyball in a sunny park: a man dives for the ball and loses his hat, a woman leaps to spike over the net, and the mixed teams end up laughing and hugging on the grass.

title: player_559
asset_description: Under floodlights at night, a football player in a yellow kit dribbles past a defender in blue, fires the ball into the goal, then slides on his knees screaming with joy as teammates pile on top of him.

title: fountain_560
asset_description: A young woman takes an excited nighttime selfie in a crowded square, then the camera swings around to reveal the illuminated Trevi Fountain, panning over its turquoise water and marble statues.

title: pleasure_561
asset_description: A young woman in a grey beanie and red scarf bites into a fresh croissant outside a bakery, closes her eyes and savors it with a blissful face, saying "Oh wow". She then shares it with a friend on the bench, who tastes it and enjoys it just as much.

title: plug_562
transcript: Well, there's why. Let there be light!
asset_description: A couple's floor lamp goes dark, and they frown and investigate. Following the cable, they find the white two-pin plug lying loose on the floor, hold it up to the camera saying "Well, there's why", then push it into the wall socket and the lamp lights up again.

title: pocket_563
transcript: Where are they? In your pocket.
asset_description: A red-haired young man by a stone wall pats himself down asking "Where are they?" and digs through the many pockets of his green jacket, pulling out random things like a pebble, a wrapper and a woolly glove. Finally he fishes his keys out of a pocket and holds them up in relief while his friend sips coffee.

title: podium_564
asset_description: In a gymnastics hall, athletes push three foam blocks together to build a three-step winners' podium while teammates watch. Three gymnasts in tracksuits climb onto first, second and third place; the winner in the middle throws her arms up, then all three join hands, wave and bow.

title: politics_565
transcript: Vote for me, friends! No! Vote for me! Yeah! Well done. Good luck!
asset_description: In an animated town square, two rival candidates - a woman in an orange suit and a man in teal with a green rosette - stand on crates shouting "Vote for me!" while the crowd waves orange and green fans. Votes are painted as orange and green bars on a big board; the orange side wins a rosette, and the two candidates shake hands saying "Well done. Good luck!".

title: pollute_566
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a man tips a rusty barrel of brown sludge off his truck into a clean river between rice terraces; the muck spreads across the water while fish scatter and a chimney smokes in the hills. A girl in a yellow raincoat wading with a bucket finds the water fouled, covers her nose and says "Oh no!" sadly.

title: pond_567
asset_description: Two young people kneel at the mossy stone edge of a small garden pond ringed by ferns and purple irises. They point excitedly ("Oh wow. Whoa!") at orange goldfish gliding under the lily pads, and a fish splashes, sending ripples across the still water.

title: pool_568
asset_description: At a sunny outdoor swimming pool ringed by pink flowering bushes, a woman relaxes on an orange inflatable ring while two guys cannonball off the edge one after another, sending up huge splashes and laughter. Afterwards the men float on their backs beside her in the turquoise water.

title: postmaster_569
transcript: Open! Everybody in! They're falling! Yes boss!
asset_description: In a 2D cartoon post office, a stern grey-haired woman in uniform with a ring of keys throws open the doors shouting "Open! Everybody in!" and bosses two clerks around. Parcels tumble off the shelves, she points orders while packages are weighed and stamped, the clerks answer "Yes boss!", and she wheels a cart of parcels out the front door.

title: pot_571
transcript: Watching won't help. Look, it's dancing!
asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a young couple fills a big metal pot with water, sets it over an open fire and tips small potatoes into it. They cover it with a lid, peek inside as it boils and joke that the water is "dancing", then lift a cooked potato out on a fork through the steam.

title: potato_572
transcript: Easy and lift! Look how many!
asset_description: In a vegetable garden, a man levers a leafy potato plant out of the dark soil with a spade ("Easy and lift!") and golden potatoes tumble from its roots. A woman kneels down, picks the potatoes out of the dirt admiring how many there are, and together they fill a metal bucket with the harvest.

title: pouring_573
transcript: (upbeat music) - Steady, steady. - Not a drop!
asset_description: A young barman in an apron pours orange juice from a big plastic jug into a row of glasses on a wooden counter, filling them one by one. He shows off by pouring from higher and higher - "Steady, steady. Not a drop!" - while a woman watches open-mouthed, and every glass ends up neatly filled.

title: powder_574
asset_description: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".

title: power_bank_575
asset_description: On a park bench, a young man despairs over his dead phone - "No plugs anywhere!" - throwing his hands up. His friend digs a power bank out of her bag ("Pocket power!"), they plug the phone into it on the bench, watch it charge and celebrate with a fist pump.

title: pray_576
transcript: Please, I pray for a good grade. I pray and I pray. I want to pass my exam, please, or pass my--
asset_description: A stressed student at a desk piled with textbooks and a laptop presses her palms together, looks up at the ceiling and begs "Please, I pray for a good grade... I want to pass my exam". She dramatically pleads into the camera with clasped hands and desperate eyes.
speech_sentences: Please, I pray for a good grade.
I want to pass my exam, please, or pass my

title: predict_577
transcript: No chance! Oh! Haha! You knew it!
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime seaside scene, a woman points up at a single dark cloud and calmly gets her yellow umbrella ready while the man beside her scoffs "No chance!". Seconds later rain pours down exactly as she said; she stays dry under the umbrella and he laughs, admitting "You knew it!".

title: pride_578
asset_description: A woman mechanic in overalls wheels a vintage motorcycle she has restored out of her garage onto a sunlit cobbled street and polishes its silver tank. Neighbours gather around admiring it while she stands tall beside the bike, crosses her arms and beams, saying "There! I did that."

title: programming_579
asset_description: A young couple sits at a laptop trying to code a small wheeled robot that stands on a paper track on the table. The robot won't obey, they groan with heads in hands, then type new code, and suddenly the robot drives along the drawn track - "It works!" - so they cheer, high-five and kiss.

title: protect_580
transcript: Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!
asset_description: In a 3D-animated storm on a lake pier, a tall strong woman whips off her orange coat and stretches it over a smaller bespectacled woman carrying a picnic basket, shouting "Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!". She shields her from the pouring rain all the way to a stone boathouse, then wraps the coat around her shoulders and hugs her.

title: protesting_581
transcript: (upbeat music) - Hey, hey, hey, hey! - Sign's up, everyone! - All together, now! (cheering)
asset_description: A crowd marches through a sunny city square carrying green flags, sunflowers and hand-painted signs of a tree, a water drop, a sun and green hearts. They link arms, chant together and raise the signs while cafe guests watch.

title: proud_582
asset_description: In a carpentry workshop a young woman finishes a wooden chair, presses the seat to test it, puts her hands on her hips and admires it. She sits down, crosses her arms and beams with pride while an older colleague congratulates her.

title: prove_584
transcript: No way! Okay, okay, you win.
asset_description: A 3D-animated young woman faces a doubting friend who stands with crossed arms. She kicks up into a perfect handstand, holds it while his face turns from smug to amazed, then lands; he applauds and admits she won.

title: public_585
asset_description: In a hand-painted animated city square a young woman sits on a case and plays a red accordion beside a fountain. Workers, elderly people and families stop one by one until a large crowd rings the square to listen.

title: puck_587
transcript: Ready? Here it comes! Whoa! Yes! In!
asset_description: A cartoon referee holds up a black puck and drops it for a face-off between purple and yellow teams. A player in yellow wins it, skates up the ice, fires the puck past the purple goalie into the net and celebrates holding it up.

title: puddle_588
asset_description: On a narrow street after rain, people in red and black rubber boots and bright raincoats jump together into a big puddle that mirrors the blue sky. The splash sends ripples across the water while they laugh.

title: pulling_589
asset_description: At a village tug-of-war a man and a woman strain backwards pulling a thick rope until the red marker crosses the chalk line. They win, collapse on the grass laughing, and the onlookers applaud while a dog runs over.

title: punch_590
asset_description: In a boxing gym a young woman in red gloves throws fast combinations, punching the black focus pads her trainer holds up. She works through jabs and hooks in rhythm and finishes the round laughing with him.

title: punching_bag_591
asset_description: A muscular man carries a big leather punching bag up a ladder in his garage and hangs it from a ceiling chain while a woman helps. He tests it with punches, makes it swing, celebrates and finally hugs the bag.

title: pushing_592
asset_description: Two young men lean into the back doors of a white van on a residential street, counting and pushing with all their strength. The van slowly rolls away down the road and they stand up, laugh and high-five.

title: pyjamas_593
asset_description: On a snowy winter evening a young man and woman in matching checked pyjamas warm them on a radiator, put them on and shuffle around the attic bedroom with hot drinks. They fall backwards onto the bed while their dog naps on the rug.

title: qualify_594
asset_description: In a hand-painted animated athletics meet a girl arches over the high-jump bar and lands on the mat without knocking it off. An official waves a green flag, the crowd and rival jumpers applaud, and she pumps her fists — she is through to the next round.

title: rabbit_595
asset_description: A wild brown rabbit moves through grassy dunes at sunset. It hops between tufts, sits upright on its hind legs with ears tall, nibbles clover, washes its face with its paws and bounds away.

title: race_596
asset_description: Sprinters in bright kit crouch in starting blocks on a stadium track, burst out together and sprint down the straight. The leader breaks the finish tape and the group slows, laughing and hugging each other.

title: racket_597
asset_description: On a tennis court a young woman in pink holds a black racket up to the camera, peers through the strings, spins and flips it in her hand, bounces a ball on the strings and then hits a forehand over the net, smiling.

title: rain_598
asset_description: Heavy monsoon rain pours on a village street where paper boats float down the running gutter. Two teenagers shelter under a roof, then the girl steps out into the downpour, spreads her arms and dances, soaked and laughing, while the boy and a dog join her.

title: rapid_599
asset_description: Two footballers face off one-on-one on indoor and outdoor pitches, chaining rapid stepovers, feints and direction changes to beat each other. Defenders lunge and slide in as the quick-cut compilation strings the fast moves together.

title: rat_600
asset_description: At night on a city sidewalk a rat scurries past a parked bike to a pizza box lying on a manhole cover. It stands up on its hind legs, sniffs the steam, grabs a slice and drags it across the pavement down into the open drain, cheese stretching behind.

title: razor_601
transcript: (upbeat music) - Whose morning magic? (upbeat music) - Smooth in seconds.
asset_description: A man with shaving foam on his face shaves with an electric razor at a bathroom mirror while his impatient friend behind him taps his watch and hands him a shirt.

title: reading_602
asset_description: An animated red-haired girl with glasses reads a thick book at a table on a night train through snowy mountains; a plot twist makes her gasp and cover her mouth before she sips cocoa and keeps reading.

title: receipt_604
transcript: Oh, dear. Sorry. It's still going. Here, keep it, please.
asset_description: In a hand-painted village grocery, a cashier rings up a man's basket of fruit and the old register prints an endless receipt that spirals around his body; he studies the huge list, then rolls it up and pockets it.

title: recipe_606
transcript: Step one, eggs. Just like the card.
asset_description: A couple in a kitchen follows a hand-drawn recipe card with icons for eggs, milk and a pan: they crack eggs, whisk batter, fry pancakes and finish a tall honey-topped stack, checking the card at each step.

title: refrigerator_607
transcript: Cold air heaven! All of it fresh!
asset_description: A couple opens their new empty refrigerator, enjoys the cold air, then fills the shelves with milk bottles, leafy greens, eggs and cheese before proudly posing beside the closed fridge.

title: relief_608
asset_description: A driver grips the steering wheel with a tense, worried face through a tricky parking moment; when it is over she gasps, breathes 'phew', covers her face with both hands and melts into relieved laughter.

title: rest_609
transcript: Ah, nothing. Beautiful nothing. Shall we go down? Five more minutes.
asset_description: Two cartoon hikers with huge backpacks trudge up a hill, drop their packs and flop onto the grass; they lie back on the hilltop above a patchwork valley, sighing happily and refusing to get up yet.

title: ribbon_610
asset_description: At a village vegetable show a judge carries a rosette with long blue, red and yellow ribbons past the entries and pins the blue prize ribbon onto a giant pumpkin; the young grower gasps and hugs her winning pumpkin while the crowd claps.

title: right_612
transcript: That way! Pass the fountain! Thank you! No, no! This side! Aha!
asset_description: At an animated night street market a food-cart vendor gives a lost backpacker directions, pointing firmly to the right past the stalls; he starts off the wrong way, she spins him around to the correct side, and he heads off right with a thumbs-up.

title: ring_613
asset_description: A young Muay Thai fighter in blue gloves climbs through the ropes into a boxing ring at a gym, bounces and shadowboxes around the canvas, then leans on the ropes laughing while his coach splashes him with water.

title: river_615
asset_description: Two people race autumn leaves on a crystal-clear turquoise river running over pebbles between forested banks; the leaves drift with the current past a grey heron that finally flies off low over the water.

title: rock_616
asset_description: A couple in a misty green valley push with all their strength against a giant round rock that will not move, slide off it into the grass, then climb up the boulder instead and stand on top cheering with raised arms.

title: rollerblades_617
asset_description: A young woman buckles on purple rollerblades in a park full of fallen jacaranda petals, skates along the path toward the camera, crouches into a fast glide and stops with a petal spray beside a man on a bench, grabbing his drink.

title: rope_618
transcript: Tight. Very tight. Ready? Heave! It's coming! It's coming! Woo-hoo!
asset_description: A cartoon farmer carries a coil of rope, knots it around the wheel of a cart stuck in mud, and pulls hard together with a second farmer until the cart jerks free and both tumble laughing onto the grass, rope in hand.

title: lower_619
asset_description: From a rooftop terrace a woman feeds a rope out hand over hand so that a wicker basket sinks slowly down the wall to the narrow street below, where a man waiting in the alley catches it and loads it with oranges.

title: rose_620
asset_description: In a misty rose field at sunrise a woman cradles a large pink rose in her hands, closes her eyes to smell it with delight, then holds up its long stem and points carefully at the sharp thorns.

title: row_621
transcript: Nice and even. All in one line.
asset_description: Farm workers in sun hats kneel in a field at dawn, transplanting seedlings along a stretched string so the plants form a perfectly straight line; a drone shot reveals dozens of workers planting one long straight line across the field. One says the line is nice and even.

title: rubber_band_622
asset_description: At a market herb stall, a young woman stretches an orange rubber band wide between her thumbs while a man watches amazed, then she snaps it around a bundle of fresh cilantro to hold the stems together and lifts the tied bunch.

title: rude_623
asset_description: A young man in a cafe drops into a chair, puts his muddy boots up on the table next to his croissant, and stays glued to his phone while the waitress serves him; he mutters a dismissive remark instead of thanking her and later shoves past other customers on his way out.

title: run_624
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime park scene, a girl in a blue dress sprints at full speed across the grass chasing her straw hat as the wind blows it away; she dives, tumbles, pins the hat down and puts it back on with a triumphant smile.

title: runner_626
asset_description: A female athlete in an orange kit with a race number runs a road race along a waterfront boardwalk: she grabs a paper cup of water at an aid station, drinks while running, checks her sports watch, and pushes toward the barriered finish area past cheering spectators.

title: runway_627
transcript: Whoo! Work it! And turn. Whoo!
asset_description: A young woman in a blue slip dress over a white tee struts along a long white rug in a living room as if it were a fashion-show runway, posing with a hand on her hip and turning at the end while her friends film her and shout encouragement.

title: sadness_628
asset_description: A tearful woman in a green cardigan packs the books of her little bookshop into cardboard boxes, tapes one shut and looks around at the emptying shelves; overcome, she covers her mouth, hugs one last book to her chest and sinks to the floor crying among the boxes.

title: safe_629
asset_description: Two hikers stumble out of a snowstorm into a stone mountain hut; one bolts the heavy wooden door, hangs up the wet jackets and watches the storm rage outside the window, then they feed the log stove and sit with steaming mugs, sighing with relief that they are fine now.

title: sailor_630
asset_description: A cheerful sailor in an orange jacket and life vest works on the deck of a wooden sailboat in a misty fjord: she winds a thick rope around a winch, laughs as spray bursts over the bow under the raised sails, then takes the ship's wheel and raises a fist in triumph.

title: salad_631
asset_description: A young man in a kitchen tears lettuce into a bowl, slices cucumber, cherry tomatoes and peppers, adds red onion and white cheese, and tosses everything with two spoons; he lines up a row of bowls and a friend tastes one with a fork, nodding approval.

title: salt_632
asset_description: In a stone kitchen by the sea, a hand pinches coarse white salt from a small wooden pot and sprinkles it over a board of ripe tomato slices while a seagull watches through the open window; a couple licks salt from their fingers and bites into the salted tomatoes with bread, delighted at the taste.

title: sand_634
asset_description: On a beach at sunset a young man lets dry sand pour from his fist into his other palm and shows a handful mixed with tiny pebbles; bare feet press footprints into the wet sand, a woman draws a big spiral in it with a stick, and a wave washes over the drawing.

title: sandals_635
asset_description: A woman buckles a pair of tan leather sandals on her bare feet on a sunny boardwalk; she and a man in brown sandals walk together by the water, she dips a sandalled foot near a tiled fountain, and the camera keeps returning to their strappy open shoes.

title: sandwich_636
transcript: layer layer layer crown look at those stripes
asset_description: At a lakeside picnic a woman builds a sandwich on a wooden board: she butters white bread, layers ham, cheese, tomato, lettuce and cucumber, presses a second slice on top and cuts it in half to show the striped filling, then happily takes a bite while a duck watches.
speech_sentences: layer layer layer crown look at those stripes

title: pomegranate_637
asset_description: In an orchard, hands score the skin of a large red pomegranate with a knife, slice off its crown, and slowly pull the fruit open into flower-like segments packed with glistening red seeds, held above a crate of more pomegranates.

title: sauce_638
asset_description: At an outdoor table by a vineyard, a man ladles bright green herb sauce from a stone bowl over a plate of grilled potatoes, aubergine and pepper; egged on by his partner shouting for more, he keeps pouring until the whole plate is flooded in sauce, and they taste it laughing.

title: sausage_639
transcript: Roll them. Roll them. Snap here that.
asset_description: At a campsite between mountains and a fjord, a man fries a row of sausages in a black pan on a small camp stove, turning them with tongs until browned; he lifts one on a fork, pops it into a long bun and a woman wrapped in a blanket takes a happy bite.

title: scale_640
asset_description: In a gym, a muscular woman steps barefoot onto a big white dial scale, then picks up two dumbbells and gapes in mock shock as the needle jumps higher; a giant bodybuilder takes her place and flexes his biceps at the spinning needle while she laughs and points.

title: scale_641
transcript: Climbing. Climbing. Stop! Your turn apparently.
asset_description: A young couple in a rustic kitchen weighs ingredients on a vintage kitchen scale, placing a bowl on it and pouring flour in while watching the dial. Then their tabby cat jumps onto the scale and sits on it, and they laugh.

title: scar_642
transcript: Hot pan, two years ago. Hah, mine is bigger. Boys, look at this. [gasping] [laughing]
asset_description: Three animated friends sit around crates of mugs on a beach pier at sunset comparing scars: a red-haired woman rolls up her sleeve to show a forearm scar from a hot pan, a bearded man shows a bigger one on his arm, and a third friend tops them both with a huge scar along his shin.

title: scared_644
asset_description: A woman with a tote bag walks alone through a dim underground parking garage, hears something, calls out 'Who's there?', lights her phone flashlight, then presses her back against a pillar with wide eyes and both hands clamped over her mouth.

title: schedule_645
asset_description: An animated man in a teal shirt stands at a big wall planner calendar in an office, pinning colored magnets on different days, circling one date with a marker and ticking it, then steps back satisfied saying it is sorted.

title: science_646
transcript: I love science. Look what happens.
asset_description: A woman in a lab coat, safety goggles and purple gloves says she loves science, mixes two blue liquids in a beaker, and a huge tower of orange foam erupts out of it; she reacts wide-eyed with delight and holds up the foam-filled tube in triumph.

title: scissors_647
asset_description: In a home kitchen a mother holds up a pair of scissors, then trims her daughter's bangs with comb and scissors while the girl sits under a towel cape; the girl checks the straight new fringe in a hand mirror and beams.

title: scold_649
transcript: Look at my cabbages! I forgot the gate. How many times? Sorry, Grandma.
asset_description: In a hand-painted countryside scene, an old grandmother wags her finger and angrily tells off her grandson by the cabbage patch because he left the gate open and geese got in; he hangs his head, clutches his straw hat, apologizes and shuffles off to close the wooden gate.

title: screw_650
transcript: Oh, there you are! Holds solid!
asset_description: A couple assembling a flat-pack chair finds one screw missing; the man crawls around the living room searching until he spots the last screw near a cardboard box, holds it up in triumph, drives it into the chair leg with a screwdriver, then sits on the finished chair to prove it holds.

title: screwdriver_651
asset_description: A young couple mounts a wooden wall shelf: the woman takes a red-handled screwdriver and tightens the screws in the metal bracket while the man watches nervously, then they load books onto the shelf and she proudly shows off the screwdriver as it holds firm.

title: sea_652
asset_description: Waves splash over white coastal rocks by clear turquoise water; a young couple runs off the smooth rocks and jumps into the sea, surfacing and swimming while one laughs that the water is salty.

title: searching_653
transcript: They were right here! Oh, you're kidding!
asset_description: A frantic couple turns their apartment upside down searching for lost keys: she digs under couch cushions and through drawers, he crawls under the sofa and shakes out a backpack, they argue by the front door - where the keys turn out to be hanging in the lock the whole time.

title: secret_654
transcript: Come here. Closer. Really? Shh! What are you two doing?
asset_description: On a lantern-lit rooftop at dusk, an animated young woman pulls her friend close and whispers a secret into her ear; the friend gasps, they both press fingers to their lips going shh, then sit side by side acting innocent when a man peeks over and asks what they are doing.

title: serious_655
transcript: Come on, smile! Not now. I'm working. Okay.
asset_description: A hand-drawn animated calligrapher keeps a stern, focused face while two friends try everything to distract her - popping up with party hats, horns and spoons over their eyes; she never smiles, paints one perfect brush stroke, and stares them down while they wilt.

title: distract_656
asset_description: A young woman sits at a chess board in a tournament hall while the spectators packed behind the rope barrier behind her wave their arms, pull faces and gesture at her to break her concentration; she never looks up, and calmly reaches out and moves a piece.

title: serve_657
asset_description: A Pixar-style animated woman carries a tray of steaming noodle bowls across a sunset terrace, sets a bowl in front of a delighted man at the table saying 'Here you go', then pours water from a clay jug into his glass.

title: shampoo_659
asset_description: In an animated hair salon, a green-haired stylist pumps shampoo from a bottle into her hand and lathers a client's black hair into an absurd swirling foam tower like soft-serve ice cream, then rinses it out and reveals a giant glossy hairstyle with a thumbs-up.

title: a_basin_660
asset_description: A big white enamel basin stands on a wooden stool in a garden and everything happens over it: a woman leans her head down into it, her friend washes her hair above the water, the soapy water collects inside, and at the end a can of clean water is poured over her hair back into the basin.

title: shark_661
asset_description: A shark swims through a swirling ring of small silver fish above a coral reef, then glides right up to the camera and opens its tooth-filled mouth in extreme close-up.

title: sharpener_662
transcript: Blunt as a spoon. Needle point.
asset_description: At a wooden table on a grassy steppe with a horse grazing behind, a young woman shows a blunt pencil, a man twists it in a small sharpener so a wood shaving curls out, and she holds up the now needle-sharp pencil before drawing in a notebook.

title: shaving_foam_663
asset_description: In a bathroom, a young man sprays a tall swirl of white foam from a can into his palm while his friend watches in exaggerated amazement, then he slathers it over his cheeks and chin like a fluffy foam beard in front of the mirror.

title: shaving_664
asset_description: In a barbershop, a woman barber brushes white lather onto a reclining man's stubbled face, carefully scrapes it off with a straight razor, then pats scented oil onto his smooth cheeks while he jokes that it stinks.

title: sheep_665
asset_description: A very woolly black-faced sheep grazes on a misty green hillside, lifts its head, bleats loudly with its mouth wide open right into the camera, then turns and trots off toward the flock in the distance.

title: shirt_666
asset_description: A young man takes a light-blue button-up shirt off a hanger, puts it on over his white T-shirt, buttons it up and fixes the collar and cuffs in front of a mirror while a woman watches approvingly and smooths the fabric.

title: shock_667
asset_description: A young woman carrying a helmet walks up to find her white scooter lying knocked over on the pavement; she gasps, freezes with wide eyes, clutches her head with both hands and crouches over the fallen scooter in disbelief.

title: shoes_668
asset_description: A close-up shows someone sliding a foot into brown leather shoes with a shoe horn, lacing them up with a double knot, then walking out onto a brick street, splashing through a puddle and meeting a friend holding coffee.

title: shop_669
transcript: How much please three coins my friend, thank you come again
asset_description: In a retro cartoon, a woman in a red coat enters a little grocery shop, fills her basket with jars and a loaf of bread, pays the friendly bald shopkeeper three coins at an old cash register, and leaves through the door under the striped awning.
speech_sentences: How much please three coins my friend, thank you come again

title: shopping_670
asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D supermarket, a young woman with curly red hair pushes a cart along the shelves, picks out apples, bread and a carton of milk, pays the cashier with coins and walks off happily with her bag.

title: shouting_671
asset_description: Two hikers with backpacks stand on green terraced mountain slopes with a llama behind them, cup their hands around their mouths and shout 'Hello!' across the valley at the top of their lungs, then laugh and rub their sore throats.

title: showering_672
asset_description: At an outdoor beach shower, a young woman in a wetsuit rinses off under the cold water, shrieking and hugging herself, then pulls her laughing friend under the spray; they both rinse the sand off and dry themselves with towels.

title: shrink_673
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime laundry room, a red-haired girl loads her big red sweater into the washing machine, then pulls it out again shrunk to doll size and holds the tiny sweater up in horrified disbelief.

title: sick_674
asset_description: A young woman wrapped in a blanket sits on a sofa blowing her nose into tissues and rubbing her aching head; a man brings her a steaming mug of tea, tucks a blanket around her, and she sips it looking miserable.

title: side_675
asset_description: In a boatyard, a young man rolls blue paint along the white side of a big wooden boat; more workers join in with rollers until the whole side of the hull is painted bright blue from bow to stern.

title: sightseeing_676
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime Venice, a tourist couple with a camera admires the bell tower and pigeons on a grand square, points at a domed cathedral, then rides a gondola under a bridge along the canals taking photos of the sights.

title: silk_678
asset_description: In a fabric shop stacked with cloth, two women admire a length of shiny emerald-green silk: they let it pour like water, toss it into the air, press its smooth surface to their cheeks, and laugh as it keeps sliding off the polished counter while a white cat watches.

title: silver_679
asset_description: In an anime workshop, a silver-haired woman takes tarnished black discs and a dull chain from a box and rubs them with a cloth until they shine bright mirror-silver; she puts on the gleaming silver earrings and chain and admires the sparkle.

title: singer_680
asset_description: In a recording studio, a young woman wearing headphones sings her heart out into a large studio microphone, one hand on her headphones, while producers work at the mixing desk behind the glass; she finishes the take laughing happily.

title: singing_681
transcript: Everybody, second verse! One, two la la la la la! We should start a band.
asset_description: A bearded man and a woman drive through a desert valley and sing along loudly together, pumping fists and laughing as they belt the song.
speech_sentences: One, two la la la la la!

title: sink_683
asset_description: A man fills a white kitchen sink with water and dish soap until a huge foam mountain rises, then he and a woman wash dirty plates in it and finally the water drains away.

title: sister_684
transcript: Oh, finally! Mom, I'm back! My two girls.
asset_description: In a hand-drawn farmhouse kitchen a girl comes home through the door and her sister jumps up from breakfast to hug her; they pose together and then their mother joins the hug under a family portrait.

title: size_685
transcript: Too small! Too big! This one fits.
asset_description: At a seaside hat stall a girl tries on straw hats: one is far too small, the next is comically huge and swallows her whole head, and finally the vendor hands her one that fits perfectly and she walks off happy.

title: skateboard_687
asset_description: A curly-haired teen on a sunset city plaza takes his skateboard, shows it to the camera, then rides it across the stone square and lands a little jump before skating off toward the view.

title: skin_688
asset_description: A young woman does her skincare routine: she pats cream onto her face in the bathroom, pumps lotion into her palm and rubs it along her arms, then finishes on a balcony stroking her glowing cheeks.

title: skirt_689
asset_description: A woman in a park shows off a mustard-yellow pleated skirt: she holds the waistband, lifts the fabric to show how it hangs, walks down stone steps and twirls so the skirt flares out.

title: sky_690
asset_description: A young couple in a green field tilts their heads back to gaze at a huge blue sky with wispy clouds and tiny birds; the camera sweeps up across the clouds and they end up lying in the grass looking up.

title: guard_691
transcript: Hey! Get away from my car! Move! Go! (laughing)
asset_description: A soldier in camouflage chases a stranger away from his parked car, then struts and patrols around it swinging a wooden stick, pokes at the doors, climbs halfway through the window and tumbles onto the dirt road before laughing into the camera.

title: sleeping_692
transcript: Mmmmm. Best spot ever. Half open.
asset_description: In a cozy log cabin a man yawns and stretches, flops onto the bed, pulls the knitted blanket over himself and falls asleep with his eyes closed while a woman reads and a cat watches in the background.

title: sleepy_693
transcript: (upbeat music) Oops. Just five more minutes.
asset_description: A woman with purple hair rides a night train: she yawns into her hands again and again, rubs her eyes, and slowly her head sinks against the window until she dozes off with a notebook on her lap.

title: slice_694
asset_description: A 3D-animated young chef slices a tomato into a neat fan of thin rounds on a wooden board, then proudly holds one translucent slice up to the light with a big grin.

title: smiling_695
asset_description: In a 2D cartoon, a glum woman on a sunny ferry rests her chin on her hand while an old sailor beams at her; her frown slowly melts into a wide smile until the whole bench of passengers is smiling and laughing together.

title: smoke_696
asset_description: A couple burns a pile of autumn leaves in their backyard; a huge column of thick grey smoke billows up, drifts over the man until he is completely wrapped in it, and he coughs and waves it away while the woman laughs.

title: smoking_697
asset_description: Outside a bar at night a bearded man smokes a cigarette and taps the ash into an ashtray; nearby a woman lights an older woman's cigarette, and the smokers stand together puffing clouds under the street lights.

title: smoothie_698
asset_description: A woman at a juice bar blends berries and fruit into a thick purple drink, pours it into tall glasses, tops each with a strawberry, sips through a straw, and her friends clink their glasses together.

title: smuggle_699
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene a farmer hides a big wheel of cheese under the hay in his cart, calmly wheels it up to a border checkpoint where a stern guard pats the hay and raises the barrier, then behind the rocks he pulls the cheese back out and grins in relief.

title: snail_700
asset_description: A close-up of a brown-shelled snail gliding slowly across a wet stone path in the rain, leaving a silvery trail, stretching its antennae and climbing onto an orange autumn leaf.

title: snake_701
asset_description: A pale sand-colored snake slithers down a desert dune, leaving a winding track in the rippled sand, then coils up on a flat black rock and flicks its tongue at the camera.

title: sneakers_702
asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a young red-haired woman in purple workout clothes laces up a pair of bright teal sneakers on a stone ledge, then happily bounds and jumps up the colorful hillside stairs of a seaside town.

title: sneeze_704
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime meadow, a young man holding a big bouquet of dandelions builds up to an enormous sneeze that blows his straw hat off and scatters dandelion seeds everywhere, while a girl beside him first ducks, then giggles as he wipes his nose with a handkerchief.

title: sneezing_705
asset_description: At a flower market, a young woman smells the tulip bouquet her boyfriend gave her and keeps sneezing into her elbow while he laughs; moments later he catches it too and sneezes himself, leaving both of them laughing among the flower stalls.

title: snow_706
asset_description: In a snowy village street at dusk, a young couple catches a snowflake on a white mitten, tilts their heads back to catch falling snow on their tongues, then flops onto the fresh snow and lies there laughing.

title: snowboard_707
transcript: Just this. All good. No way!
asset_description: On a sunny mountain slope above a fjord, a rider in a turquoise suit straps both boots onto an orange snowboard, rides off carving down the piste, and stops with a playful spray of snow next to a friend sitting on the slope.

title: soap_708
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime garden, a young man picks up a pale bar of soap at a stone outdoor sink, lathers his muddy hands into thick white foam, rinses them under the tap, and admires his clean hands as a bubble floats by.

title: suds_710
asset_description: In a sunny courtyard a young woman rubs a soap bar under a brass tap until the white suds in her hands swell into a huge cloud; a man watches open-mouthed and applauds before she rinses the suds down the basin.

title: socket_711
asset_description: In a plant-filled cafe, a man's phone is nearly dead, so a woman points him to a white wall socket hidden behind a big monstera; he plugs the charger into the socket, leaves the phone charging on the floor, and they toast with iced coffees.

title: soda_712
asset_description: At a rooftop picnic, a man suspects his friend shook his orange soda can, holds it to his ear and listens before daring to open it; nothing explodes, so he pours the fizzy orange soda over ice, drinks, and grins in relief.

title: soil_713
asset_description: Two gardeners scoop up handfuls of dark crumbly soil from a raised bed, let it fall between their fingers and find a little earthworm in it, then plant spring-onion seedlings into the soil, pat it flat and water the row.

title: soldier_714
asset_description: A young soldier in dress uniform walks through airport arrival doors with a duffel bag, spots his family waiting with a heart-painted sign, drops the bag and runs to them, ending in a big tearful group hug.

title: someone_715
asset_description: A woman arrives at her office desk and finds a coffee, a fresh bun and a smiley-face sticky note that someone left for her; she scans the open-plan office and questions a coworker trying to work out who it was, then gives up and happily sips the coffee holding the note.

title: soup_spoon_716
transcript: That's not nothing! Now you're eating!
asset_description: A man lines up a teaspoon, a soup spoon and a giant ladle on a wooden table, then eats his bowl of vegetable soup testing them by size: tiny sips with the teaspoon, proper spoonfuls with the soup spoon, and finally huge comic mouthfuls straight from the ladle until the bowl is empty.

title: soup_717
transcript: hot hot hot careful warms everything
asset_description: In a cozy log cabin, a woman tastes steaming tomato soup from a big pot, ladles it into a bowl, swirls cream on top and hands it to a man wrapped in a blanket on the sofa, who blows on each hot spoonful and eats it happily with a cat beside him.
speech_sentences: hot hot hot careful warms everything

title: south_718
asset_description: On a frosty field at low sun, a woman points up at a long V of geese migrating across the sky; a group of villagers climbs over a stone wall, plants a wooden direction post, and walks off across the stubble field following the birds toward the horizon.

title: space_719
asset_description: Two teenagers recline in planetarium seats as the dome above them fills with a glowing Milky Way star field; they gaze up open-mouthed while the galaxy slowly drifts overhead.

title: spice_720
transcript: Wow, that's strong! Look at the color!
asset_description: At a night souk, a vendor scoops bright red spice powder from tall colored mounds into a paper cone; a couple sniffs it and the man's eyes go wide at how strong it is. At home they sprinkle the spice into a hot pan of oil, where it blooms into a red star, then cook peppers in it and taste the dish.

title: spilling_721
asset_description: A cartoon woman at an outdoor picnic table laughs and waves, knocking over a full glass of water; the water floods the whole table and drips onto the grass while she and a boy stare in shock.

title: spine_723
transcript: Bone, bone, bone, all the way down. Now stand up tall. Ooh, much better.
asset_description: In a clinic, a young man with back pain bends over; a doctor points down the row of vertebrae on a skeleton model, then the man straightens his back, stands tall and feels better.
speech_sentences: Bone, bone, bone, all the way down.

title: a_splash_724
asset_description: At a packed outdoor pool, divers jump from high boards and towers one after another; each landing throws up a bigger and bigger burst of water while spectators film, ending with an enormous column of water.

title: spring_726
asset_description: A young couple sits under cherry trees in full bloom as petals rain down; fresh green buds open on a branch, a duck leads ducklings across a pond, the man peels off his jacket in the new warmth and they lie back on petal-covered grass.

title: sprint_727
asset_description: An animated female runner powers down a stadium track at top speed, breaks the red finish tape ahead of the others, then bends over panting and breaks into a happy smile.

title: squirrel_729
asset_description: In a park full of red autumn maples, a grey squirrel climbs a tree trunk, sits on a branch nibbling a nut by a tree hole, then dashes along a thin branch with an acorn in its mouth and leaps away.

title: staff_730
asset_description: Inside a busy restaurant, the whole team works together: the chef passes plates over the kitchen counter, waiters carry stacked dishes to tables, a waitress throws a fresh tablecloth and lays cutlery, a barman serves coffee, and at the end the crew poses arm in arm.

title: stamp_731
transcript: This little thing sends it. Off you go.
asset_description: On a sunny Indian street, a man peels one flower stamp off a full sheet, sticks it onto the corner of an envelope, and a woman then drops the letter into a red pillar postbox with a crow perched on top.

title: state_733
transcript: My country signs today. Mine signs too. Two free nations. Friends.
asset_description: In a grand marble hall, two animated leaders wearing sashes each press a wax seal onto a treaty document in front of their national banners, one teal with a circle and one orange with a triangle, then shake hands and pose side by side as their delegations applaud.

title: steak_734
transcript: That crust, listen. Rested, now perfect.
asset_description: A man lays a thick raw ribeye into a cast-iron pan over a gas flame, sears it, bastes it with butter and thyme, rests it under foil, then slices it open to show a pink center and tastes a piece while his beagle watches over the counter.

title: steam_735
transcript: Whoa, the cloud! I see nothing!
asset_description: In a cozy winter cabin kitchen, a man lifts the lid off a big pot and an enormous cloud of steam billows up, completely fogging his glasses so he cannot see; his friends laugh and wave the white cloud away while holding mugs.

title: stepbrother_736
transcript: So, you're the new one? Looks like it. Hi! One family now. Boys! Photo now!
asset_description: At an outdoor garden wedding, a red-haired bride marries a bald mustached groom; afterwards her red-haired son and the groom's son are pushed together, exchange an awkward handshake and fist bump, then hug and join the new family photo.

title: stepfather_737
asset_description: A man bonds with his wife's son: he fixes the boy's blue bike in the driveway and gets a high-five, guides his hands to flip a pancake at the stove, and the boy then runs into his arms for a big hug while the mother watches happily from the doorway.

title: sticky_note_738
asset_description: A man draws a lunchbox inside a heart on a pink sticky note, peels it off the pad and presses it onto the fridge door; his partner comes home, spots the pink square, smiles, and opens the fridge to find the packed lunchbox waiting.

title: stop_739
transcript: What is on the sign? Stop for pizza, okay?
asset_description: A man in a red hoodie walks down a city street and halts at a red octagonal sign that reads STOP FOR PIZZA; he shrugs, obeys the sign, walks to a sidewalk pizza cart and happily takes a bite of a slice.

title: stopwatch_740
asset_description: At a running track at dusk, a coach clicks an analog stopwatch as a sprinter takes off, stops it the moment she finishes, then stares at the dial in disbelief and celebrates the record time with her.

title: storm_741
transcript: [MUSIC PLAYING] Whoa! [MUSIC PLAYING] Listen to it.
asset_description: A couple sits cozily by a window with mugs of tea while outside a violent storm bends a birch tree, rolls a barrel down the street and sends huge waves crashing over a harbor pier.

title: stove_742
transcript: Click, click, hoo. Click, click, click, hoo. All four going.
asset_description: In a spice-filled kitchen a man clicks the gas stove burners alight one by one, blue flames appear, and a couple sets pots, a pan and a kettle on all four burners to cook together.

title: straight_743
asset_description: Two bricklayers lay a row of bricks exactly along a stretched string line; the woman sights down the perfectly straight row, winks, then points down a road that runs dead straight to the horizon.

title: stranger_744
asset_description: On a rainy city street a woman drops her papers at a bus stop and an unknown man kneels to help gather them, shelters her under his umbrella, and walks her to the red double-decker bus, where she waves goodbye.

title: stream_746
asset_description: A couple kneels beside a clear, narrow stream winding through a green sheep pasture, dips their hands in the cold flowing water, floats a small leaf boat on it, and finally jumps across it laughing.

title: stress_747
asset_description: A cartoon office worker juggles a phone call while towers of paperwork rise around her desk; she sweats, clutches her head, cries out and finally collapses face-down on the clipboard.

title: stretch_749
asset_description: Two runners in a birch park warm up: they reach their arms high overhead, lean to the side, bend down to touch their toes, and help each other with a partner stretch before jogging off.

title: string_750
asset_description: In a sunny bakery a worker pulls white string from a spool, loops and crosses it around a white pastry box, ties a neat bow, and the customer carries the box away hanging from the string.

title: style_751
transcript: Wear this one, like ours. No, this is me. Wait! Me too!
asset_description: In an animated clothing store two friends in matching beige outfits offer a blue-haired punk girl the same jacket; she refuses and builds her own bold look with a yellow checkered jacket, red scarf and purple platform boots, posing in the mirror while the amazed friends end up draped in colorful scarves.

title: sugar_752
transcript: Whoo strong for courage Now it's right
asset_description: A woman sips black coffee in a cafe and grimaces at the bitter taste; her partner spoons white sugar from a small bowl into the cup and stirs it, and her next sip makes her smile.
speech_sentences: Whoo strong for courage Now it's right

title: suit_753
asset_description: In a tailor's fabric shop a man takes a bright blue suit from the rack, pulls on the jacket over his t-shirt, buttons it and turns proudly in front of the mirrors while his partner admires the fit.

title: support_754
transcript: I can't! I've got you! Push! I did it! Yes!
asset_description: In an anime rooftop scene a woman strains at a pull-up bar and cannot lift herself; her friend grips her feet from below and pushes her up until she finishes the pull-up, and they celebrate with a handshake.

title: surface_755
asset_description: A woman in a workshop runs her hand over different flat tops: she sweeps dust off a wooden table, pours clear resin that sets into a glossy sheen, rolls a wooden wheel across a polished stone table, and finally admires a huge mirror-shiny factory floor.

title: surfboard_756
asset_description: On a tropical beach a woman rubs wax onto her long white surfboard, carries it into the sea, paddles out lying on it, pops up to ride a small wave, and hugs the board laughing in the shallows.

title: surprise_757
asset_description: On a rooftop terrace a man hands a woman a plain cardboard box; she opens it, gasps with her hands over her mouth, and lifts out a tiny puppy she was not expecting, hugging it with delight.

title: swan_758
asset_description: A white swan glides on a calm lake, curls its long neck to preen its feathers, dips its orange beak, then rears up flapping its huge wings and splashes across the water past small dark ducks.

title: sweater_759
asset_description: On a rainy day indoors a red-haired woman unfolds a cream cable-knit sweater, presses it to her cheek, pulls it on over her shirt and snuggles into the collar with a hot mug beside her boyfriend.

title: swell_760
asset_description: In a Pixar-style park scene a jogger hobbles to a bench, pulls off his sock, and watches his hurt ankle balloon into a huge round lump; he gasps, pokes it, and presses a blue ice pack on the swelling.

title: swelling_761
asset_description: A young woman sits on a couch with her feet up; one foot and ankle are visibly red and puffy compared to the other. A shocked man points at the swollen foot and presses an ice pack onto it while she winces.

title: t_762
transcript: No. No. Maybe. That one. One second. Done.
asset_description: A man browses a drawer of folded shirts while a woman watches, picks out a teal T-shirt, sniffs it happily, pulls it on over his tank top and checks himself in the mirror as she applauds.

title: tablecloth_763
transcript: Three, up and over. Smooth, perfect.
asset_description: On a seaside terrace at sunset, a couple throws a white tablecloth high into the air, lets it float down over a wooden table, smooths it flat and then sets plates and glasses on top; a cat walks across at the end.

title: tablet_764
asset_description: An animated young man in a desert diner holds up a tablet and draws on its white screen with his finger, sketching a cactus that fills in green, then leans back happily comparing his drawing with the real cactus outside the window.

title: tattoo_766
transcript: Exactly like the sketch! It's forever!
asset_description: In a tattoo studio, an artist peels the protective film off a woman's upper arm to reveal a fresh bird-and-rose tattoo. She gasps in delight, compares it with the paper sketch the artist holds up, and both give thumbs up.

title: tea_767
transcript: Look, they're dancing! From up here, steady.
asset_description: On a Moroccan-style tiled table, a couple spoons dried leaves and fresh mint into a glass teapot, pours in hot water, watches the brew turn amber, then pours the tea into small glasses from high up and sips it together.

title: team_768
transcript: Together and hold! All six now! Yeah! Yeah! That was all of us!
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime scene, a rowing crew in matching teal shirts pulls their oars in perfect unison across a misty lake at sunrise, the small coxswain shouting the rhythm. They cross the finish, raise their oars together and lift her up in celebration.

title: teaspoon_769
transcript: Plop and stir. Tiny but mighty.
asset_description: Close-up of small silver teaspoons dipped into Turkish tea glasses on saucers; a couple stirs their tea with the tiny spoons, lifts them out and tastes a spoonful each while a cat naps on the windowsill.

title: tennis_770
asset_description: A woman in tennis whites serves and rallies against an opponent on an orange clay court lined with cypress trees, sprinting between shots, diving full length for a ball and ending on her knees catching it as onlookers applaud.

title: terminal_771
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime, a woman with a rolling suitcase walks through sliding doors into a vast glass airport terminal, passes the check-in counters, rides an escalator and watches planes on the runway through the huge windows.

title: therapy_772
asset_description: A tearful young woman hugs a pillow in an armchair and talks to a grey-haired therapist who listens with a notebook. She cries, takes a tissue, gradually starts smiling, and leaves the session relieved, shaking the therapist's hand.

title: thermometer_773
transcript: Open under the tongue. Ah. Oh, you are very hot. Broo-hoo, cold.
asset_description: In a retro cartoon, a nurse shakes a glass thermometer and puts it in a sick man's mouth; the red line rockets up as his whole face glows red like a stoplight, so she dumps a bucket of ice on his head and the reading sinks back down.

title: thinking_775
transcript: Wait, wait, almost... There it is!
asset_description: A man at an outdoor chess table frowns at the board, strokes his chin, taps his temple and even stands up and paces while his amused opponent waits. At last the idea comes, he makes his move and both players react excitedly.

title: thirst_776
asset_description: A sweating cyclist stops on a scorching dirt track and tips his water bottle high over his open mouth, but only a last drop falls out. He grimaces with a dry mouth, stares longingly at sprinklers watering a distant field and keeps shaking the empty bottle.

title: thirsty_777
asset_description: A young vegetable seller at a busy market clutches his dry throat, tips up his water bottle and finds it empty, then gratefully takes a glass of water a hand passes him and gulps it down in one go.

title: thread_778
asset_description: In a sunny tailoring workshop, a young seamstress pulls a long red thread off a wooden spool while her colleague marvels at how thin it is. She threads it through fabric, sews a seam, snips the end with scissors and both hold up the finished cloth.

title: an_otter_779
asset_description: A small otter rests its head and webbed paws on a person's bare arm, gazing into the camera. It snuggles against the person's sleeve, blinks sleepily and closes its eyes contentedly as a hand strokes its cheek.

title: stand_780
asset_description: Three house cats stand fully upright on their hind legs in a row on a plaid bed, holding the pose like little soldiers. One by one they wobble, bat a paw at the camera and drop down, then rise to stand again.

title: thunder_781
asset_description: A couple sits at a candlelit table in a rustic stone kitchen while a storm darkens the window behind them; lightning flashes and they count "one, two, three" on their fingers waiting for the boom, then throw up their hands when it hits, while their big dog hides under the table.

title: tie_782
transcript: Over. Under. Through. Too short. Over. Under. Through. There we go.
asset_description: A young woman knots a dark red tie around the collar of a man's white shirt, chanting "over, under, through"; the first knot comes out too short, so she redoes it and pats the finished tie flat.

title: tiger_783
asset_description: A wild tiger pushes through tall dry grass in a jungle, wades chest-deep into a forest river, splashes and snarls toward the camera, then climbs out on the muddy bank.

title: tilt_784
asset_description: A cartoon woman in a green jumpsuit and headwrap stands on a sunny boardwalk, grips the pole of a striped beach umbrella and tilts it over so the shade covers her deck chair, then settles back into the chair with a satisfied "Better."

title: timetable_785
asset_description: A cartoon boy with a shoulder bag stands on a rural station platform studying a big wall timetable showing trains next to clock faces; he compares it with his wristwatch, spots his departure and points at the row, then runs down the platform and hops aboard the green steam train just in time.

title: tired_786
asset_description: A construction worker hauls a heavy wooden crate up a narrow staircase onto a sunny rooftop, straining and wiping sweat from his face; after setting the crate down he slumps onto a step, arms hanging over his knees, panting and gasping "that's it."

title: to_judge_787
transcript: My friend does something silly, but I do not judge her.
asset_description: In a bright cafe, a woman with iced drinks glances sideways at her friend, raises her eyebrows as the voiceover says her friend did something silly "but I do not judge her", then breaks into a warm smile and the two clink their glasses.
speech_sentences: My friend does something silly, but I do not judge her.

title: to_microwave_788
transcript: Ow! Hot, hot! My next please.
asset_description: In an anime kitchen at night, a green-haired boy puts a bowl of noodles into a microwave, starts it and watches the bowl spin and steam; he pulls the hot bowl out with an "ow, hot, hot!", puts on oven mitts, and a girl points at the microwave asking for hers next.

title: toaster_789
transcript: Down and glow. Pop! Cut it!
asset_description: Two men lower bread slices into a stainless-steel toaster, turn its dial and lean in nose-to-nose, staring dead-serious at the glowing slots until the toast pops high into the air; one snatches a slice from the air and they grin and bite into their toast.

title: tomato_790
transcript: still warm smell that juicy look at it
asset_description: At sunset in a garden, a man picks a big ripe tomato off the vine, smells it, then slices it into a stack on a wooden board, salts it and adds a basil leaf; he bites into a juicy slice and shares the board with a woman.
speech_sentences: still warm smell that juicy look at it

title: tool_791
transcript: Nope, wrong one. That one, done.
asset_description: Two men fix a bicycle mounted upside down outdoors next to a pegboard hung with tools; one grabs pliers and gets told "nope, wrong one", then browses the wrenches, screwdriver and hammer, picks the right wrench and holds it up grinning before turning the bolt.

title: toothpaste_792
asset_description: In a Pixar-style bathroom, a woman in a lilac bathrobe squeezes toothpaste onto her toothbrush, but the paste keeps flowing out into a huge wobbling spiral tower; she stares at it wide-eyed, scrapes a normal blob back onto the brush and happily brushes her teeth.

title: top_793
asset_description: On a windy hill summit, a woman in a purple jacket stacks flat stones onto a tall rock cairn, reaching higher and higher until she balances the last stone on the very top, then steps back and spreads her arms in triumph.

title: tournament_794
transcript: Ready, go! You are strong. Champion on the left!
asset_description: In a Ghibli-style seaside village, crowds watch an arm-wrestling tournament at rows of tables while an official moves portrait tokens up a wooden bracket board after each match; a small bald boy beats a huge bearded sailor in the final and is lifted up as champion.

title: towel_795
asset_description: A Pixar-style muscular man climbs dripping out of a pool, grabs a striped towel from a lounger and rubs his face and hair dry until it stands up in wild spikes; his wet dog shakes water over him, so he laughs and wraps the dog in the towel too.

title: track_797
asset_description: Relay runners train on a red stadium running track at sunset: a woman sprints around the curve with a baton and hands it to a teammate, he runs on down the marked lanes into the low sun, and the last runner crosses with arms spread while the team cheers.

title: tracksuit_798
asset_description: A woman zips up a turquoise tracksuit jacket, tightens the matching drawstring trousers and dances in an old Italian alley under laundry lines; three friends in identical turquoise tracksuits join her and they strut and squat-dance down the cobbled street together.

title: training_800
asset_description: Footballers run an evening training session on a floodlit pitch: one dribbles a ball through orange cones while the coach shouts "again!", the squad hops through an agility ladder in bibs, does sit-up drills, and finally collapses on their backs laughing.

title: trampoline_801
asset_description: A young woman in a coral outfit bounces higher and higher on a netted backyard trampoline while a friend watches from the grass. She does a straddle jump with arms spread, then flops flat onto her back on the mat as he applauds.

title: trash_can_802
transcript: (upbeat music) - For the win. - Switch! (upbeat music)
asset_description: A woman with a microphone commentates like a sports announcer while a man shoots crumpled paper balls at a mini basketball hoop mounted above a teal trash can. He celebrates a made shot, then picks up the missed paper balls off the floor and drops them into the open can.

title: travel_804
transcript: I love to travel. I take a plane and I see new places.
asset_description: A POV journey: rolling a suitcase through an airport hall, holding up passports with boarding passes, walking down the plane aisle, watching clouds through the window, then stepping out among palm trees at a sunny tropical destination. The traveler says she loves to travel, takes a plane and sees new places.
speech_sentences: I take a plane and I see new places.

title: traveling_805
transcript: That's ours! Run! And? We're off! We're really going!
asset_description: A young couple with rolling suitcases sprints along an alpine platform and jumps onto a train just in time. They heave their bags onto the overhead rack, flop into seats, and excitedly unfold a paper map while snowy mountains and a lake slide past the window.

title: tray_806
transcript: Up high, steady. Not one drop.
asset_description: A waitress in a cafe loads a wooden tray with coffee cups, a copper pot, glasses and cake, then carries it high overhead on one hand across the busy room, dodging a customer. She sets the fully loaded tray down on a table without spilling a drop and the guests applaud.

title: treadmill_807
asset_description: A young woman with a red hair bun runs on a treadmill in a bright gym, breathing hard as the pace picks up. She finishes the run, slows the machine with the console buttons and wipes her forehead with relief.

title: tree_808
asset_description: Two friends walk across a golden meadow at sunset toward a huge old oak tree. They press their hands against its rough bark, say how big it is, and crane their necks up at the massive trunk and spreading branches above them.

title: trend_809
transcript: Everyone has one! And now me too!
asset_description: Two friends walk through a European old town and realize with growing shock that everyone around them wears the same yellow bucket hat - cyclists, cafe guests, grandmas, even a passing corgi. The boy gives in, grabs a yellow hat from a street stand and proudly puts it on while his friend facepalms.

title: trophy_811
asset_description: A women's indoor soccer team in blue jerseys sprints toward a golden cup waiting on a stand in a packed arena. One player lifts the trophy over her head screaming with joy, then the whole team hoists it together under falling confetti while the crowd cheers.

title: trust_812
asset_description: High on a cliff face, a climber double-checks the knot on her rope while her belay partner waits on the ground below. After a quick "Ready?" and his "Got you!", she lets go of the rock, leans back into the rope and hangs over the huge drop with her arms spread wide, relying on him completely.

title: turkey_813
asset_description: A large male turkey struts around a farmyard in autumn, fanning out its huge brown tail feathers and gobbling, with other turkeys in the background. It hops up onto a hay bale and poses with its tail spread wide.

title: turn_off_814
asset_description: In a cozy attic room at dusk, an animated girl with round glasses pulls the cord of the hanging light bulb so it goes dark, then presses the button on a standing fan and its blades spin to a stop. She smiles, satisfied, by the darkened window.

title: turtle_815
asset_description: A sea turtle crawls across white sand between big rocks on a tropical beach, reaches the water and slides in. It then glides underwater over a coral reef and swims up toward the sparkling surface.

title: tuxedo_816
asset_description: A woman in a green evening gown ties a black bow tie for a man in a white dress shirt. He pulls on the black jacket, buttons it and checks himself out in a full-length mirror, clearly impressed with the finished formal look.

title: side_by_side_817
asset_description: A fluffy white cat and a black cat sit side by side on a concrete block by the shore, seen from behind, calmly watching the waves roll in at dusk. They stay pressed close together the whole time, tails hanging over the edge.

title: typing_818
transcript: How are you that fast? And done.
asset_description: In a library, a young woman hammers away at a laptop keyboard at absurd speed while the guy next to her watches with his jaw dropping. Her fingers fly over the keys, he asks how she is that fast, and she throws her arms up in triumph when she finishes.

title: umbrella_819
transcript: Just in time. Room for me?
asset_description: On a rainy shopping street, a woman pops open a big red umbrella just in time and smiles up at it as the rain patters down. A soaked man in a hood dashes over asking for room, ducks under, and the two walk off sharing the umbrella.

title: underwear_821
asset_description: A cartoon lumberjack in a log cabin takes a white undershirt from a drawer and puts it on first, then piles on a sweater, puffy jacket, hat and scarf before stepping into a blizzard; back inside he strips down to his underwear and gives a cozy thumbs up.

title: a_screen_823
asset_description: In a bright open-plan office a desktop monitor shows a colorful marketing dashboard with charts, and a hand reaches in and points at the screen while someone works at the keyboard.

title: a_view_825
asset_description: A golden dog on a leash sits beside its owner in a flowery alpine meadow, both facing a panorama of jagged rocky peaks under a blue sky; near the end the dog turns back and licks the owner's hand.

title: film_826
asset_description: A film crew in dark clothes shoots a scene in a bright office: one operator rides a camera dolly, another holds a boom microphone, and big studio lights surround a man sitting at a desk.

title: an_animal_827
asset_description: A storybook watercolor scene full of animals - an owl, giraffe, cow, zebra, hippo, dog, pig, goat, hen, lion cub and elephant - slowly turns from black-and-white to full color while printed labels fade away.

title: surprised_828
asset_description: Two young women sit with coffees at a marble table in a busy cafe; one listens and grins while the blonde makes a big surprised face with her mouth open, and they both burst out laughing.

title: explain_830
transcript: You have to add motion there.
asset_description: An older woman with grey hair stands over a young designer's desk, points at app mockups on his tablet and explains what to change; he looks up at her, nods and gets back to work with his stylus.
speech_sentences: You have to add motion there.

title: a_speech_831
transcript: It's not just about the message, but how we deliver it.
asset_description: A dark-haired woman in a navy suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a packed auditorium, gesturing energetically as she speaks to the seated audience, then folds her hands and smiles.
speech_sentences: It's not just about the message, but how we deliver it.

title: unpack_832
asset_description: A cartoon man in a plaid shirt opens his suitcase on a hostel bed and unpacks it: folded clothes onto the shelf, a towel on the hook, a plush octopus by the pillow, and then an impossibly long striped scarf that keeps coming until it piles up on the floor.

title: unpacking_833
asset_description: A young couple kneels by a suitcase in a bright living room after a trip; the man happily pulls out clothes and shoes, celebrates that a seashell survived, the woman tries on a straw hat, and they tip the whole case out until a cat walks over the clothes pile.

title: a_hostess_834
transcript: Enjoy your meal. You are the best hostess! Do you have pineapple please? Could you pass me the water? You are taking advantage of me a bit as a hostess.
asset_description: A young woman in a flowery dress serves a big roast turkey to a table full of excited guests, brings out pineapple on demand and even pours water straight into a guest's mouth, then plants her hands on her hips, fed up with being used.
speech_sentences: Could you pass me the water?
You are taking advantage of me a bit as a hostess.

title: a_plumber_835
transcript: You as a plumber are my only chance. I'll be honest, I will say I'm just an electrician. I'll fix it!
asset_description: A man in a blue polo kneels with his toolbox in a bathroom while the desperate homeowner begs him to help; he stares in wide-eyed panic, then wrenches the pipe under the sink until water blasts him in the face and he lands soaked on the floor.
speech_sentences: You as a plumber are my only chance.
I'll be honest, I will say I'm just an electrician.

title: prepared_836
transcript: Did you come here to sleep? I am a prepared student.
asset_description: A boy walks through a crowded school hallway carrying a giant expedition backpack with ice axes, a rolled sleeping mat and a tower of books stacked on top; amazed classmates watch as he proudly declares himself ready, then tips backward onto his sleeping roll to rest.
speech_sentences: Did you come here to sleep?

title: a_taxi_837
transcript: [MUSIC PLAYING] This taxi driver deserves a tip.
asset_description: From inside a yellow taxi, the driver weaves through busy city traffic and squeezes the cab through an impossibly narrow alley between buildings, then grins back at his passenger, proud of the shortcut.
speech_sentences: This taxi driver deserves a tip.

title: a_pilot_838
asset_description: A young man in a brown leather pilot jacket struts through an airport terminal past admiring cabin crew, then poses selfie-style in front of a huge jet engine at sunset, running a hand through his hair.

title: extend_839
asset_description: In a high-rise apartment an older man shows off his dining table: he slides it apart, drops extension leaves into the middle and the table grows to twice its length; he celebrates, planks on the matching bench and finally sits at the huge table.

title: hike_840
asset_description: A young man ties his boots by an alpine chalet, hikes up a forest trail over tree roots, reaches a viewpoint above a turquoise mountain lake, takes a happy selfie and then sits on a rocky ledge eating fruit while looking over the valley.

title: melt_841
asset_description: A bored young woman scoops ice cubes into a glass kettle and switches it on to melt them, watching until the ice turns to water. She celebrates, then pours the little jug of melted water into a huge swimming pool.

title: a_baby_842
asset_description: A mother sits on the living-room floor with her baby, who reaches for colorful wooden alphabet letters scattered on the wood floor. The baby coos and grabs at the toys while the mother smiles.

title: up_843
asset_description: In a colorful hillside street, two girls on a balcony haul a fruit basket up on a rope while their friend below cheers. She then climbs up a tall ladder to join them, and together they watch a hot-air balloon rise up into the sky.

title: valley_844
asset_description: A hiking couple reaches a grassy ridge and stops in awe above a huge green valley where a silver river winds between steep cliffs. They spread their arms, point at the view and dance around happily.

title: vanishing_845
asset_description: On a black-sand beach an animated girl draws a big spiral in the wet sand with a stick. A wave rolls in and the whole drawing vanishes without a trace; she gasps, draws it again, and the sea erases it again.

title: victory_847
asset_description: In a hand-painted anime rowing race, a determined crew sprints their red boat down a lantern-lined river and crosses the finish line first, breaking the tape. They raise their oars, hug, and carry the rower on their shoulders while the crowd cheers.

title: vinegar_848
transcript: So sour! Wow! Just a splash.
