Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

title: weigh_4509
asset_description: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.

title: check_4510
asset_description: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.

title: service_4511
asset_description: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

title: list_4512
asset_description: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

title: suitcase_4513
asset_description: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.

title: skill_4514
asset_description: A cartoon restaurant kitchen. A grinning chef in a tall white hat and white jacket stands in the middle: one hand tosses a copper frying pan whose contents (a lobster, prawns, bell peppers, onion rings and mushrooms) fly up in a huge sheet of orange flame, while the other hand holds out a steaming wooden spoon. Behind him three other cooks in white hats watch him and cheer, one with a pot lid, one with a whisk, one with a knife. Copper pans hang on the wall and plated dishes with silver cloches wait on the pass under warming lamps.

title: win_4515
asset_description: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

title: hay_4516
asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon inside a wooden barn. A plump speckled brown-and-white hen has just launched herself off her nest and hangs in mid-air with her wings spread, eyes shut and beak open, loose feathers drifting around her. Below her sits a round nest built of dried yellow grass with three pale eggs in it and two more eggs on the ground beside it. The whole barn floor is covered in the same loose dried yellow grass and more of it is heaped in the stalls behind.

title: pull_4517
asset_description: A dark woodcut-style print of a Victorian rooftop. A young sweep in a flat cap and long coat braces himself on the steep slate roof, one boot on the tiles and one against the brickwork, and grips a rope with both hands, one high and one low. The rope runs up over the tall brick chimney stack and down into one of its clay pots. Thick black smoke pours out of the pots and blows across a grey sky, and the roofs and chimneys of the town stand behind him.

title: ash_4519
asset_description: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

title: stretch_4520
asset_description: An ink-and-colour illustration of the Great Wall. In the foreground a woman in a long blue coat and a scarf climbs a broad stone staircase carrying a painted paper lantern, and a red flag flies from the watchtower above her. Behind her the wall runs on and on in one unbroken line: over a green ridge, down into cloud, and up again over the far blue mountains until it disappears at the horizon. Pine trees cling to the slopes and swallows dart over the battlements.

title: distance_4521
asset_description: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.

title: tour_4522
asset_description: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.

title: fold_4524
asset_description: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.

title: help_4525
asset_description: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

title: election_4526
asset_description: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

title: vegetable_4527
asset_description: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

title: grave_4528
asset_description: A woodcut of a village church at night. The tall stone tower with its pointed spire rises against a swirling blue sky with a crescent moon and stars; a bell hangs in the open window of the tower with its rope swinging, and a flock of black crows scatters away from it. Warm light shows through the pointed stained-glass windows and small figures in pale robes walk in through the open wooden doors. All around the church, leaning stone markers stand in the rough grass over the buried dead, with a bare tree on each side.

title: color_4529
asset_description: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.

title: film_4530
asset_description: A dark cinema drawn in black and white. At the front a wide screen glows bright blue with a blurred moving picture on it, and a broad beam from the projector cuts through the dark air above the rows of seats. Most of the seats are empty and a few silhouetted heads watch from the rows. In the middle a man has jumped up out of his seat and is hurling a bucket of popcorn into the air; the popcorn scatters through the beam and over the seats around him while the man in front of him ducks away.

title: popcorn_4531
asset_description: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

title: trash_4532
asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

title: court_4533
asset_description: A photograph in a wood-panelled courtroom. A woman in a patterned dress stands in the middle of the floor in front of the bench and holds a large certificate with a ribbon seal up over her head with both arms, laughing. Behind her an older man in a suit and three other family members clap and wave small paper flags, two little boys among them, and paper confetti falls through the light from the tall window. A small flag stands on the desk beside a signed document, and seated guests watch from the front row.

title: official_4534
asset_description: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

title: lesson_4535
asset_description: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

title: craft_4536
asset_description: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.

title: clear_4537
asset_description: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

title: rest_4538
asset_description: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

title: cartoon_4539
asset_description: A hand-drawn comic-style picture with thick black outlines, flat colours and motion lines. A grinning man with round white eyes, a patched apron, big yellow rubber gloves and brown shoes swings a mop across a blue-and-cream chequered floor. Sparkle stars and soap bubbles pop off the wet tiles. A grey mop bucket on castors, full of suds and fitted with a wringer, stands to the right. Behind him are office windows with a drawn city skyline, a potted fern and a radiator.

title: equipment_4540
asset_description: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

title: filthy_4541
asset_description: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

title: agreement_4542
transcript: Hmm, this one. We have a deal.
asset_description: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.

title: risk_4543
asset_description: A pencil-and-charcoal drawing of a huge sea cliff seen from the side. The rock face is a sheer, layered wall dropping straight into the sea, where white surf boils around its foot. A single thin rope runs down the middle of the face, and a tiny figure hangs on it about halfway down, dwarfed by the rock. Seabirds wheel in the empty grey sky to the left; tufts of coarse grass grow on the ledges at the bottom right.

title: contrast_4544
asset_description: An illustration split straight down the middle into two opposite halves. The left half is burnt orange desert: cracked dry ground, bare dead trees, a white blazing sun and grey rocky hills. The right half is deep blue ice: jagged frozen slabs, snow-laden fir trees, falling snow and heavy grey cloud. Down the seam between them rises a column of white steam shot through with glowing blue lines. A metal machine stands on each side, one in the sand, one on the ice, and a metal platform runs along the bottom of the frame.

title: strength_4545
asset_description: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

title: surgery_4546
asset_description: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.

title: waiting_room_4547
asset_description: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

title: late_4548
asset_description: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

title: fuel_4549
asset_description: A charcoal drawing in blacks and greys. A bare forearm grips the wooden handle of a shovel and tips its load of chunky black lumps forward; the lumps and a shower of black dust fall through the air onto a big heap of the same shiny black rock below. Behind is a dim brick cellar lit by a single bare bulb hanging on a flex. Some of the lumps have spilled out over the drawn border onto the pale grey paper.

title: finally_4550
asset_description: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

title: camp_4551
asset_description: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.

title: hair_4553
asset_description: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

title: flame_4554
asset_description: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.

title: pine_4555
asset_description: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

title: praise_4556
asset_description: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

title: lap_4557
asset_description: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

title: support_4558
transcript: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.
asset_description: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.

title: console_4559
asset_description: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.

title: crew_4560
asset_description: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

title: command_4561
asset_description: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

title: direction_4562
asset_description: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.

title: law_4563
asset_description: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

title: cooperation_4564
asset_description: A soft watercolour of a village barn raising on a summer meadow. A long line of villagers in waistcoats and caps leans back on a rope, hauling a big wooden roof frame upright, while an old man in a straw hat stands on the platform pointing and directing them. On the left, women in aprons carry trays of loaves and pies out from a trestle table under an awning; a girl holds a basket. Children run across the grass with buckets and tools for the men on the ladder, and thatched cottages sit behind.

title: globe_4565
asset_description: An anime-style painting of the inside of a spacecraft. A child in an orange spacesuit with a white life-support pack and a tether floats up to a big round porthole, seen from behind, with both gloved hands pressed against the glass. Filling the window is the earth as one enormous blue and green ball, wrapped in white cloud, with the land masses spread across it. Instrument panels with glowing screens and bundles of cable line the walls, and a strip of black starry sky shows through a second window above.

title: summit_4566
asset_description: A photograph taken at sunrise from the highest rocks of a mountain. A woman in an olive jacket and a climbing harness pulls herself up over the last granite slabs, one hand flat on the rock and the other arm swung up behind her, her hair blown across her face by the wind. Below and behind her, ridge after ridge of bare mountain drops away into a hazy valley with a pale river winding through it, and the ranges fade into blue haze at the horizon under a streaked dawn sky.

title: ill_4567
asset_description: A soft cartoon of a young woman standing in a bright room with a bookshelf, potted plants and a sunlit window behind her. She wears an olive green jumper over a white collared shirt. She has turned her head away, screwed her eyes shut and pulled up her arm to cough hard into the crook of her elbow, her cheeks flushed pink, with little motion lines drawn beside her face.

title: continent_4568
asset_description: A school yard with a giant world map painted across the tarmac in bright colours, each land mass a different colour. A girl in an orange hoodie and rainbow trainers jumps from land mass to land mass, landing squarely on the yellow one, then hopping on across the map. Her classmates in tracksuits stand in a wide ring around the edge of the map watching her. She finishes by landing with both feet on the white land mass at the bottom right and throwing her arms out wide, laughing at the camera.

title: fry_4569
asset_description: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

title: chef_4570
asset_description: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.

title: push_4571
asset_description: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.

title: correct_4572
asset_description: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

title: secret_4573
asset_description: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

title: cold_4575
asset_description: A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

title: count_4576
asset_description: A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.

title: country_4577
asset_description: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.

title: crop_4578
asset_description: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.

title: abroad_4579
asset_description: A woman in a denim jacket sewn all over with national flag patches grins into the camera from behind a spinning school globe. The shot cuts to her in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris with both arms thrown up, then to a selfie on the back of a scooter riding past green rice terraces in Bali, then to her standing on the crest of a desert dune at sunset with her arms spread wide, and finally jumping on the dune towards the camera.

title: date_4580
asset_description: A cartoon of a diner with a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a jukebox and neon signs on the wall. A boy and a girl lean their heads together over one tall milkshake glass topped with whipped cream and a cherry, each drinking through their own bent straw. Their hands are joined on the table in front of the glass, both are blushing, and a pink heart-shaped balloon floats above them.

title: candy_4581
asset_description: A cartoon of a den built out of blankets over a sofa in a sunlit living room. Inside it a boy in a blue hoodie holds up a lit torch and points at a stack of cushions, while a girl in dungarees kneels beside him laughing with her hand at her mouth as she eats a sweet. A striped bowl heaped with wrapped and jelly sweets floats between them, with loose sweets scattered around it, under a string of paper stars and hearts. Teddy bears sit on the sofa behind.

title: measure_4582
asset_description: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

title: calf_4583
asset_description: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

title: trail_4584
asset_description: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

title: crossing_4585
asset_description: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

title: crosswalk_4586
asset_description: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

title: cyclist_4587
asset_description: A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.

title: traffic_4588
asset_description: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.

title: pedestrian_4589
asset_description: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

title: vacation_4590
asset_description: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.

title: ship_4591
asset_description: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.

title: foot_4592
asset_description: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

title: hospital_4593
asset_description: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

title: together_4594
asset_description: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

title: cry_4595
asset_description: A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

title: nose_4596
asset_description: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

title: culture_4597
asset_description: A watercolour of an evening folk festival under a canopy strung with paper lanterns. Two couples in embroidered shirts and waistcoats dance in the middle of a wooden floor; the woman in front spins so hard that her striped red skirt and the coloured ribbons in her flower crown fly out around her. On the right a fiddler draws his bow, in the foreground a drummer beats a big frame drum, and market stalls hung with pottery and woven cloth stand behind, where other people clap along.

title: huge_4598
asset_description: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

title: payment_4599
asset_description: A close-up at a market stall in low evening sun. A hand tips a small drawstring cloth pouch upside down over a scrubbed wooden counter, and coins and folded paper notes in red, green and cream pour out of it and tumble through the air. A dozen coins have already landed and lie scattered across the boards. Brass balance scales, glass jars and a wicker basket stand blurred behind.

title: exchange_4600
asset_description: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

title: arrange_4601
asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

title: search_4602
asset_description: A fine pen-and-ink drawing of a customs hall. An open suitcase on a metal bench shows neatly folded shirts and trousers; a uniformed officer in a peaked cap holds a rolled sleeping bag up above his head and squints at it. Beside him a worried traveller in a long coat stands with her hands clasped under her chin. To the right a second officer holds a spaniel on a lead, and the dog has its front paws up on the bench with its nose towards the case. Booths, striped barriers and a turnstile fill the background.

title: road_4603
asset_description: A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

title: wire_4605
asset_description: A comic-style illustration of a red and cream tram running along rails set into a cobbled street. Its scissor-shaped arm is pressed up against the overhead line, and a burst of yellow lightning-bolt sparks flies off where the two pieces of metal touch. More lines run across the pink sunset sky to the corners of the frame. A girl in a yellow jacket leans out of an open tram window with her blue scarf streaming behind her, pigeons flap up from the cobbles in front of the tram, and a castle and a gothic tower stand on the hill behind.

title: tower_4606
asset_description: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.

title: copper_4607
asset_description: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

title: crowd_4608
asset_description: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

title: dad_4610
asset_description: A warm illustration set in the hallway of an old house. A little girl in a red patterned dress and pigtails comes flying down the staircase, one arm swinging a leather school satchel, the other stretched out ahead of her. At the bottom a man in a tweed jacket and tie has dropped into a crouch with both arms wide open to catch her, grinning up at her. A grandfather clock, a coat rack with hats and coats, a patterned rug and the front door fill the hall behind them.

title: daughter_4611
asset_description: A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.

title: sell_4612
transcript: Oh, wow. For you, the best.
asset_description: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.

title: earth_4613
asset_description: An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.

title: hang_4614
asset_description: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

title: colorful_4615
asset_description: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

title: wood_4616
asset_description: A pencil sketch of a misty wood. Tall bare tree trunks rise on every side and thin branches criss-cross the pale sky, with fog drifting between them. In the middle a large stag with wide branching antlers rears up over a fallen mossy log, front hooves off the ground and head thrown back, its breath steaming in the cold air. Dry leaves swirl around its legs in the wind.

title: fight_4617
asset_description: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

title: charge_4618
asset_description: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

title: raw_4619
asset_description: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

title: overnight_4620
asset_description: A charcoal drawing of an airport terminal in the middle of the night. A young man lies stretched across a row of metal seats with one arm flung over his forehead, a backpack beside him and a wheeled suitcase parked at his feet. Behind him more stranded passengers sleep across the seats, curled up in their coats. A big round clock on the wall reads about half past four. Beyond the black glass wall, planes sit on the dark apron. A cleaner pushes a mop cart down the empty concourse and a crushed paper cup lies on the floor.

title: passenger_4621
asset_description: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

title: sigh_4622
asset_description: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.

title: vote_4623
asset_description: A cartoon of an election count. A tall wooden ballot box painted in red, white and blue stripes is tipped on its side above a long wooden trestle table, and folded paper slips pour out of it onto the tabletop. A heap of the slips has already built up in the middle and more flutter through the air. Smiling officials in suits and hats stand along both sides of the table with their hands out, ready to spread the pile and sort it. Behind a rope barrier a crowd of onlookers watches, and banners hang on the brick wall above them.

title: majority_4624
asset_description: A photograph looking down a packed town hall with a bare wooden floor and tall windows. More than a hundred people of all ages sit on rows of plain wooden chairs, and almost every one of them has a single hand raised straight up in the air to vote. Papers rest on their laps. A long empty table with stacks of paper and three chairs faces them at the front of the room. Sunlight falls in stripes across the floorboards between the rows.

title: vote_4625
asset_description: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

title: leave_4627
asset_description: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.

title: sad_4628
asset_description: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

title: endless_4629
asset_description: A woodcut print in ochre, orange and brown. Sand dunes roll away one behind another, their curving ridges carved in fine parallel lines, until they blur into a flat line at the horizon with no end in sight. A tiny robed figure with a walking staff is climbing one of the ridges far off, no bigger than a thumbnail against the sand. In the foreground a bleached longhorn cattle skull lies half buried in the dune. A large stylised sun hangs in the empty yellow sky above.

title: haircut_4630
asset_description: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

title: design_4631
asset_description: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

title: workspace_4632
asset_description: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

title: desperate_4633
asset_description: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

title: reach_4634
asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a young woman with a backpack standing at the end of a sandy coastal path, seen from behind with both arms thrown up in the air. Below and ahead of her lies a colourful seaside town of pastel houses around a turquoise bay full of small boats, with hills and a warm orange sky behind. Wildflowers grow beside the path in the foreground.

title: destination_4635
asset_description: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

title: lighthouse_4636
asset_description: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.

title: destroy_4637
asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.

title: rubble_4638
asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

title: liquid_4639
asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a hand tipping a dark bottle over a kitchen sink. A thick blue-green stream pours out of the bottle's neck in a smooth curve and falls into the sink, where it breaks into swirling waves and masses of white foam. A brass tap sits on the left and two patterned plates lean in the soapy water on the right.

title: detergent_4640
asset_description: A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

title: diet_4641
asset_description: A young man in a blue apron stands at a white kitchen counter with an open box of two chocolate doughnuts on one side and a bowl of strawberries on the other, and points away from the doughnuts. He puts out three empty plastic food containers and fills them with chicken, quinoa, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, then stacks the filled containers into a tall tower and sets the bowl of strawberries on top.

title: pit_4642
asset_description: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

title: production_4643
asset_description: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

title: excuse_4644
transcript: I'm so sorry. Work. Right. Sorry.
asset_description: A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.

title: attach_4645
asset_description: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

title: divorce_4646
asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a wooden table seen close up. Two gold wedding rings lie on the bare tabletop. A large hand on the right has just set one ring down and is drawing back from it, while a second hand reaches in from the left towards the other ring. Behind them a city skyline is sketched in soft grey.

title: spin_4647
asset_description: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

title: examine_4648
asset_description: An illustration of a consulting room in which a woman in a white coat crouches in front of a small boy sitting on the examination couch. She holds the disc of her stethoscope against his chest and rests her other hand on his head while she listens; the boy holds a teddy bear and looks worried. Behind them are an eye chart, a shapes chart, a lamp and a glass cabinet of bottles; a reflex hammer and a lollipop lie on a metal tray in front.

title: teddy_4649
asset_description: An illustration of a small boy in a striped jumper and jeans sitting on a green examination couch, hugging a brown plush teddy bear against his chest with both arms. A man in a white coat leans over him and holds a stethoscope to the boy's chest while resting a hand on his head. In the room there is a glass cabinet of medicine bottles, a fern on top of it, and a second stethoscope, a lollipop and instruments on the counter in front.

title: reaction_4650
asset_description: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

title: marine_4651
asset_description: A soft watercolour painting of the open sea at sunset. A grey bottlenose dolphin arcs through the air above the water, its body dripping, with a second dolphin breaking the surface just behind it. Below, green-blue waves catch the golden light and white spray rises where the dolphins left the water. The sky is peach and pink, with a low dark coastline on the horizon.

title: compete_4652
asset_description: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

title: mud_4653
asset_description: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

title: doubt_4654
asset_description: In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.

title: dress_4655
asset_description: In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.

title: mount_4656
asset_description: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

title: drink_4657
asset_description: In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.

title: drive_4658
asset_description: A point-of-view shot from inside an open-topped vintage car: two tanned hands hold the thin black steering wheel while the car rolls down a narrow cobbled village street between whitewashed houses with people walking ahead. The road opens onto a coastal highway with the blue sea and cliffs on the left, and the wheel turns as the car follows the bends. The camera then shows the driver herself, a woman in a colourful shirt and sunglasses, one hand on the wheel, looking out at the ocean as she drives along the clifftop road.

title: car_4659
asset_description: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

title: pile_4660
asset_description: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

title: fall_4661
asset_description: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

title: supply_4662
asset_description: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

title: drop_4663
asset_description: A pastel cartoon in soft pinks and greens. A hand in a blue sleeve squeezes the pink rubber bulb of a glass pipette held above a child's forehead. A single large rounded bead of clear liquid has just left the glass tube and hangs in the air, catching the light, with a smaller one still forming at the tip. Below it the child tilts her face up with her eyes shut tight and her mouth pursed, waiting for it to land. A labelled glass bottle stands on a shelf behind them.

title: dose_4664
asset_description: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

title: accident_4665
asset_description: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

title: smash_4666
asset_description: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

title: plane_4667
asset_description: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.

title: smell_4668
asset_description: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

title: laundry_4669
asset_description: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

title: roof_4670
asset_description: Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

title: machine_4671
asset_description: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

title: reed_4672
asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a pond. A brown duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet drops down onto the water with its wings spread, throwing up a tall white splash and rings of ripples. Two yellow ducklings paddle nearby. Both edges of the picture are filled with tall green reeds and broad water-plant leaves rising straight out of the shallow water, with hills and clouds behind.

title: weak_4673
asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon in an old gym. A skinny character with thin rubber-hose arms and legs tries to lift one huge dumbbell in one gloved hand. The weight drags his arm and shoulder down, his knees buckle, his face is screwed up and drops of sweat fly off his head. Racks of barbells and dumbbells and a much bigger dumbbell lying on the floor fill the room around him.

title: shelf_4674
asset_description: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

title: careful_4675
asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon of an Amsterdam canal street. A wide-eyed young man in a coat and a striped scarf races over the hump of a cobbled canal bridge on an old bicycle, so fast that both wheels have left the ground and he is flying.
